item.description: ［東京 ７日 ロイター］ - 日銀の佐藤綾野審議委員は７日付の共同通信のインタビューで、「現在の金融環境は緩和的だ」...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日銀利上げ「景気殺さぬタイミングで」と佐藤審議委員、段階的な調整に賛成　メディアの取材に 8:05 配信

9月18日、日銀本店前で撮影。 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

［東京　７日　ロイター］ - 日銀の佐藤綾野審議委員は７日付の共同通信のインタビューで、「現在の金融環境は緩和的だ」とし、政策金利を「段階的に調整していくという方針には賛成している」と述べた。同日付の朝日新聞が掲載したインタビューでは、今後の利上げについて「様々なデータに基づき、景気を殺さないような利上げのタイミングがいいのではないか」と話した。

佐藤委員がメディアのインタビューに応じるのは６月の就任以来初めて。佐藤委員は９月の金融政策決定会合で、同じく高市政権に任命された浅田統一郎委員とともに利上げに反対票を投じた。

共同通信のインタビューでは、今後の利上げのタイミングについて「消費や所得の動向などを確認したい」としたが、ペースについては「半年に１度とか、３カ月に１度とか、特定のペースであるべきとは思っていない」と話した。

item.title: Samsung's Q3 profit seen jumping nine-fold, but chip margins may be flat
item.description: Samsung Electronics is expected to report a nearly nine-fold jump in third-quarter operating profit, driven by robust AI demand, though analysts have cut forecasts by nearly 8% since the end of August.
item.dc:creator: Hyunjoo Jin
item.content:encoded: Samsung Electronics is expected to report a nearly nine-fold jump in third-quarter operating profit, driven by robust AI demand, though analysts have cut forecasts by nearly 8% since the end of August. Despite moderating gains in the prices of memory chips and a strengthening South Korean won, the world's largest memory-chip maker is expected to post operating profit of 106.1 trillion won ($79.1 billion) for the July-September quarter. The LSEG SmartEstimate, based on forecasts from 21 analysts, and weighted toward those with stronger track records has been slashed by 7.7% since the end of August. It will be up from 12.17 trillion won a year earlier for Samsung's (005930.KS) fourth consecutive quarter of record operating profit, underscoring a prolonged memory shortage as demand for AI infrastructure outstrips supply growth. Chipmakers expect the shortage, which began more than a year ago, to persist into next year and perhaps through 2028. However, the pace of price increases slowed in the third quarter, fanning concerns that chip margins may have peaked and prompting questions about the durability of the AI spending boom. Samsung will provide preliminary Q3 results on Thursday before detailed data is released in late October. The moderation in memory prices is being closely watched by investors after a more than one-year-long rally fuelled by AI-driven demand. That rally propelled the world's largest memory producers Samsung, SK Hynix (000660.KS) and Micron (MU.O) , to record profits and margins. RISING COST BURDEN Higher chip prices have pushed up the cost of smartphones and consumer electronics, weighing on demand. At the same time, long-term supply deals between chipmakers and customers have limited price gains in exchange for guaranteed supply. TrendForce expects conventional DRAM contract prices to rise 10% to 15% in the fourth quarter from the preceding quarter, slowing from a second-quarter surge of roughly 60%. "Although the market remains in a tight supply position, the pace of price growth is expected to decelerate," said Avril Wu, its senior vice president for research. Suppliers are wary of further steep price increases that could hurt demand across a broad range of consumer electronics, Wu added. "In addition, long-term agreements represent an increasingly higher proportion of suppliers' total output. With ceiling-price mechanisms built in, the rate of price increases has slowed down," Wu said. In July Samsung said it aimed to secure long-term contracts covering about two-thirds of its memory output, joining rivals seeking to reduce exposure to the industry's boom-and-bust cycles. US rival Micron [USN:L6N45M1AE TEXT:"said"] the chip market could be tighter in 2027 and 2028 than this year, although it expects its gross margin to slip to 86.3% in the current quarter, from 87%, partly due to employee compensation costs. Samsung's memory-chip operating profit margin is expected to reach 76% in the third quarter, flat with the preceding quarter, estimates by SK Securities analyst Han Dong-hee show. It also faces growing competition from Chinese rivals, which remain concentrated in lower-end products but are benefiting from the AI-driven memory shortage. "Our industry checks indicate that an increasing number of OEMs and ODMs are adopting Chinese DRAM and NAND," Kinngai Chan, senior research analyst at Summit Insights Group, said in a report. Currency swings are another headwind. The won strengthened 14.3% against the dollar in the third quarter, rebounding sharply from 17-year lows for its biggest quarterly gain since early 1998. That reduces the value of overseas earnings when repatriated. Samsung shares have fallen about 25% from a June record but remain more than double their level at the start of the year. The company is expected to boost sales of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips, a critical component for AI data centres, as it narrows the gap with market leader SK Hynix. Samsung had lagged in HBM supplies after delays in qualifying products for Nvidia (NVDA.O) , but has gained ground this year by expanding shipments of its latest HBM4 chips. Its HBM market share is expected to rise to 34% this year from 20% last year, J.P. Morgan estimates, while SK Hynix's share is forecast to fall to 46% from 60%. ($1=1,341.7500 won)

item.title: イラン、戦争終結にはウラン濃縮能力の削減必要＝米副大統領 - ロイター
item.description: イラン、戦争終結にはウラン濃縮能力の削減必要＝米副大統領 ロイター

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-イラン、戦争終結にはウラン濃縮能力の削減必要＝米副大統領
item.description:
Jacob Bogage
[フェアバンクス（米アラスカ州） ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jacob Bogage

[フェアバンクス（米アラスカ州） ６日 ロイター] - バンス米副大統領は５日、イランが米国の要求を満たして７カ月に及ぶ戦争を終結させるには、ウラン濃縮能力の「意味のある」削減を行う必要があるとの考えを示した。一方、イランが交渉においてどのように意思決定を行っているのかは不明確だと述べた。アラスカ州での遊説後にロイターの単独インタビューに応じた。

いかなる合意においても、イランが将来の核活動縮小を約束するのではなく、ウラン濃縮能力を削減することが必要だと述べた。

「核兵器を望まないなら、なぜ濃縮度６０％の燃料が必要なのか。核兵器を製造しないという決意を示したいなら、高濃縮燃料を製造しないことだ。これは極めて基本的な前提条件だ」とし、「核兵器を製造しないという決意を示したいなら、濃縮能力について意味のある措置を取るはずだ」と語った。

米国は引き続き合意に前向きだが、イラン側が核問題で具体的に譲歩する必要があるとし、「相手の言葉と引き換えに行動するつもりはない」と述べた。

＜意思決定の仕組み不明確＞

バンス氏は、イランで誰が意思決定を担っているか確信を持てないことが事態を複雑にしているとも述べた。

米国はイランのペゼシュキアン大統領とアラグチ外相と協議を行っているが、戦争開始当初の米国とイスラエルによる共同攻撃で最高指導者ハメネイ師が死亡した後、両氏がイランの権力構造の中でどの程度の権限を持っているかは不明だとした。

「われわれが気付いたことの一つは、イランがどのように意思決定をしているのか、完全には明らかでないということだ」と語った。

イラン外務省のバガイ報道官は４日、米政府はイラン側の交渉相手が誰で、イランの意思決定システムがどう機能しているかを十分に把握していると主張。「問題は実際には逆で、米当局者の矛盾した立場や一貫性を欠く発信にある」と述べていた。

バンス氏はロイターに対し、戦況を把握するため現地の指揮官らと自ら話をしてきたと説明。重要な弾薬の不足に対する懸念を一蹴し、イラン軍はホルムズ海峡で商船を散発的に攻撃することはできるものの、同海峡を通じたエネルギー輸出を阻止することはほとんどできていないと述べた。

２０２８年大統領選については、出馬を目指すかどうか決めていないと述べた。「私はもともと物事を先延ばしにする性格だ」とし、「まだあまり考えていない」と語った。

item.description: ＥＵ拡大巡り欧州委が制度改革案、新加盟国の時限的投票権停止も Reuters

item.title: ＥＵ拡大巡り欧州委が制度改革案、新加盟国の時限的投票権停止も
item.description: [ブリュッセル ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ブリュッセル ６日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）欧州委員会は６日、モンテネグロやアルバニア、ウクライナ、モルドバなどの将来的な加盟に備えるための制度改革案を発表した。加盟拡大に伴う政治、経済面の負担に対する現加盟国の懸念に配慮し、新加盟国がＥＵの価値観を順守しなくなった場合、加盟後１５年間は既存加盟国が当該国の投票権を停止できる仕組みなどを盛り込んだ。

ＥＵは現在２７カ国。２０２２年のロシアによるウクライナ侵攻を受け、加盟国の間ではＥＵ拡大への機運が再び高まり、ウクライナも和平実現に向けた枠組みの一環としてＥＵ加盟を求めている。

欧州委は新加盟国に対する投票権停止の仕組みに加え、大規模な農業部門を抱えるウクライナへの財政支援を制限する方針や、加盟候補国をエネルギーや運輸、デジタル、防衛などＥＵの政策や経済分野に段階的に参加させる既存の取り組みを強化することも提案した。参加には各分野で定める基準を満たし、ＥＵ全体の戦略的な方向性に歩調を合わせることを求める。

複数のＥＵ高官によると、西バルカンのモンテネグロが加盟に最も近く、年末までに加盟交渉を終える可能性がある。アルバニア、モルドバ、ウクライナも有力候補とみられているが、加盟までには少なくとも数年を要する見通しだ。

フォンデアライエン欧州委員長は声明で「加盟候補国が改革を進める中、ＥＵは各国を迎え入れる準備を整えなければならない。そのためにはＥＵの制度を整え、新たな現実に合わせて政策を見直し、共通の目標を予算に反映させる必要がある」と述べた。

改革案の実現には現在のＥＵ加盟２７カ国の承認が必要。加盟国は近く、提案を巡る協議を始めるとみられる。

item.title: BHP to sell Kambalda nickel concentrator, tenements to Gold Fields
item.description: Global miner BHP said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell the Kambalda Nickel Concentrator and a package of associated tenements and mineralisation rights in Western Australia to Johannesburg-listed Gold Fields .
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Global miner BHP (BHP.AX) said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell the Kambalda Nickel Concentrator and a package of associated tenements and mineralisation rights in Western Australia to Johannesburg-listed Gold Fields (GFIJ.J) . Here are some more details: Financial terms of the transaction are confidential, BHP said in an emailed response to Reuters. The company temporarily suspended its Western Australia Nickel assets in early 2024 following oversupply in the global market. The downturn, driven in part by rising Indonesian supply and weaker prices, [USN:L8N3E682P TEXT:"prompted Australia"] later that year to designate nickel a critical mineral, making the industry eligible for billions of dollars in government support. BHP said on Wednesday it would review the future of its remaining nickel assets by February 2027, assessing options including divestment, continued suspension, a restart or closure. Gold Fields will evaluate options for the long-term use of the concentrator and offer employment to people directly supporting the asset, BHP said. The agreements are subject to regulatory approvals and other conditions. The completion is expected during 2027. Shares of BHP were down 0.8% at A$62.38, as of 2355 GMT.

item.title: Louis Vuitton designs for a warmer world at Spring/Summer 2027 show
item.description: Nicolas Ghesquiere sent light fabrics, sheer dresses and fluid tailoring down the runway for Louis Vuitton’s Spring/Summer 2027 collection, saying rising temperatures are changing the way he thinks about clothes.
item.dc:creator: CNA Luxury
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Obsessions

Louis Vuitton designs for a warmer world at Spring/Summer 2027 show

Nicolas Ghesquiere sent light fabrics, sheer dresses and fluid tailoring down the runway for Louis Vuitton’s Spring/Summer 2027 collection, saying rising temperatures are changing the way he thinks about clothes.

A model presents a creation by designer Nicolas Ghesquiere as part of his Spring/Summer 2027 collection show for fashion house Louis Vuitton during Paris Fashion Week in Paris, France, October 6, 2026. REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

07 Oct 2026 06:52AM

FAST

Louis Vuitton showed fluid jackets and slinky, sheer dresses on Tuesday (Oct 6) as womenswear creative director Nicolas Ghesquiere said hotter temperatures caused by climate change were changing his approach to developing fabrics and designing clothes. "The world is getting warm," Ghesquiere said after the show, asked about the heatwaves that swept Europe this summer. "It definitely has a strong influence, I think we all felt we needed a different wardrobe, we needed to think differently — it's almost like you have to weigh the clothes ... and see how they can perform, to think if they can be relevant today and for the future."

A model presents a creation by designer Nicolas Ghesquiere as part of his Spring/Summer 2027 collection show for fashion house Louis Vuitton during Paris Fashion Week in Paris, France, October 6, 2026. REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

Light, flowing fabrics were used throughout the spring/summer 2027 collection on simple strappy dresses, loosely fastened jackets and sheer skirts in white or pastel pink and blue. A black and white check look and dresses covered in an iridescent diamond pattern provided graphic elements in otherwise pared-back, tonal outfits. Models emerged in between Louis Vuitton-branded cars on a set made to look like a highway, with a tar floor and road markings — decor Ghesquiere said was inspired by learning that the stunning Louvre courtyard was for decades used as a parking lot for finance ministry officials, before the museum's famous glass pyramids were installed.

Models present creations by designer Nicolas Ghesquiere as part of his Spring/Summer 2027 collection show for fashion house Louis Vuitton during Paris Fashion Week in Paris, France, October 6, 2026. REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

A model presents a creation by designer Nicolas Ghesquiere as part of his Spring/Summer 2027 collection for fashion house Louis Vuitton during Paris Fashion Week in Paris, France, October 6, 2026. REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

Jackets featured flowing sleeves with some also extending into a long train trailing behind the model, and trousers were wide and fluid with long slits up the side to let air in. Small, simple handbags came in cream and lemon tones.  Ghesquiere told reporters after the show that despite the minimalist appearance, "making things extremely light is very complex and the engineering and development of fabric to fight that gravity is also very complex".

Designer Nicolas Ghesquiere appears on the runway of his Spring/Summer 2027 collection show for fashion house Louis Vuitton during Paris Fashion Week in Paris, France, October 6, 2026. REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

Louis Vuitton, the flagship brand of luxury giant LVMH, has struggled with falling sales of its famous monogrammed handbags as fewer middle-class shoppers feel they can stretch to high-end purchases. The monogram was used lightly in the collection, featuring only on a couple of handbags and a leather bomber jacket. A crowd of screaming fans outside the show greeted the arrival of K-pop star Felix, while France's first lady Brigitte Macron was among the celebrity guests, along with actors Zendaya, Emma Stone, and Saoirse Ronan.

Source: Reuters/bt

item.title: Trump diz que ninguém sabe quem está no comando do Irã
item.description: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta terça-feira que ninguém sabe quem está comandando o Irã durante a guerra dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã, que já está em seu oitavo mês.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery, Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta terça-feira que ninguém sabe quem está comandando o Irã durante a guerra dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã, que já está em seu oitavo mês. CITAÇÕES E DETALHES: “Os líderes deles se foram, o segundo escalão de líderes também se foi, e o maior problema que tenho é que ninguém sabe quem diabos está governando o país”, disse Trump. O porta-voz do Ministério das Relações Exteriores do Irã afirmou no domingo que Washington sabe muito bem quem é seu interlocutor no Irã e como funciona o sistema de tomada de decisões no país. “O problema, na verdade, é o oposto: reside nas posições contraditórias e nas mensagens confusas das autoridades americanas”, disse Esmaeil Baghaei em uma coletiva de imprensa. O líder supremo do Irã, o aiatolá Ali Khamenei, foi morto no primeiro dia da guerra dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã, que começou em 28 de fevereiro. Seu filho, Mojtaba Khamenei, assumiu o cargo, mas não é visto em público desde que ficou ferido no mesmo ataque que matou seu pai. O Irã respondeu com seus próprios ataques contra Israel e países do Golfo que abrigam bases norte-americanas. Os ataques dos EUA e de Israel ao Irã e os ataques israelenses ao Líbano mataram milhares de pessoas e deslocaram milhões. Os preços dos combustíveis, que subiram em resposta à guerra, também representam um risco para o Partido Republicano de Trump às vésperas das eleições de meio de mandato de novembro nos EUA, nas quais está em jogo o controle do Congresso. Trump, cujo índice de aprovação se mantém em um nível mínimo recorde em meio a preocupações com o alto custo de vida impulsionado pela alta nos preços da gasolina e do diesel, tem apresentado prazos e objetivos variáveis para a guerra.

item.title: Transcript of US Vice President Vance interview in Alaska
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance gave an exclusive interview to Reuters on Monday while campaigning in Alaska, a state that has emerged as a key battleground in the November elections that will determine control of Congress.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Bogage
item.content:encoded: US Vice President JD Vance gave an [USN:L6N45S099 TEXT:"exclusive interview"] to Reuters on Monday while campaigning in Alaska, a state that has emerged as a key battleground in the November elections that will determine control of Congress. This transcript of the interview, which took place after a rally at Fairbanks International Airport for Republican US Senator Dan Sullivan, has been edited lightly for length and clarity. Jacob Bogage, Reuters: Mr. Vice President, let's start here. Can you tell me about where things stand with Iran right now? Vice President JD Vance: Well, you know, we're at a place where the Iranians are trying to terrorize the world economy by shooting at commercial shipping. They're largely failing. They're hitting some ships, but not enough to stop the flow of oil and gas. So what that means is, their response to us destroying the nuclear program was to try to terrorize commercial shipping and exercise leverage over the United States of America. And where we are is, as the president said, the nuclear program's been destroyed, but every time they try to squeeze the world economy, we actually squeeze them harder. And so I think what the president has said is, look, you guys fundamentally are not in a game that's going to work out for you. Every time they try to cause damage to the world economy, they end up causing much greater damage to themselves, and eventually they're going to have to decide either to make smarter decisions or to suffer the consequences. Bogage: You've played a pivotal role in terms of American foreign policy writ large, turning how the US engages on the world's stage from conflicts without direct American interests, like Ukraine, to conflicts with direct American interests, like Iran. Tell me a little bit about what does it take for the US to resume kinetic attacks? What do you need to hear? Or, rather, what do you need to not hear? Vance: That's obviously a decision the president of the United States will make. But you know, we have to start with a fundamental goal here. The goal here is to prevent the Iranians from having a nuclear weapon, and really to prevent regional nuclear proliferation. Because, as the president's reminded people, it's if the Iranians get a nuclear weapon, then other countries will get a nuclear weapon. Bogage: Is that a larger focus than where this conflict began? Vance: To finish that question, what that means is their nuclear facilities, their enrichment facilities, have been destroyed, and we're going to ensure that they can't rebuild those facilities and rebuild their nuclear capacity. That's fundamentally the goal here, and everything else that's happening, from them terrorizing shipping to our response to that, is really a subplot of the much bigger goal of keeping them from having a nuclear weapon. Bogage: You talk about preventing regional proliferation. Is that a goal that has expanded from the original goal of this operation? Vance: No, no. I mean, I think that's one of the reasons why the president didn't want Iran to get a nuclear weapon, because he realized that if they did, then a lot of other countries would then sprint for a nuclear weapon. So, you know, you don't want the world's largest state sponsor of terrorism to have a nuclear weapon. You also don't want to radically increase the number of nuclear weapons in the world. The president hears a lot about that. It's interesting. It's something that came up in the conversation with (Chinese President) Xi (Jinping) that the president has said multiple times publicly. He doesn't like mass proliferation of nuclear weapons. It's one of the core parts of his foreign policy, and frankly, something that both Democrats and Republicans should have been a little more focused on over the last 40 years. Bogage: Who is the US negotiating with right now? Vance: Well, that's a good question. You know we're negotiating with the political leadership of the country, specifically, you know, the foreign minister has led the negotiations, the president of the country, a number of people work for them. But one of the things we picked up on is it's not totally clear how their country makes decisions. If you go back to the original agreement that we struck, it was very simple. It was not a complicated document. It basically said we're going to open up the Strait of Hormuz, the United States is going to lift our blockade, and we're going to talk about the nuclear program. That's really all it said. And they couldn't even keep the end of the bargain where they didn't shoot at commercial shipping. And our assessment of why that is, is because, yeah, you have people in the country who want to make a deal, and we're willing to talk to them. You also have people in the country who are trying to sabotage a deal, which I think is very stupid for their country. But you know, it's ultimately their decision to make. Bogage: Iran has said for 47 years, and I'm not going to weigh in on whether it's believable or not, that they don't want a nuclear weapon. How do they communicate that any differently, in a way that helps the United States wind down its operation? Vance: Well, I guess I would say, if you don't want a nuclear weapon, then why do you need 60% enriched fuel? And if you want to show commitment to not building a nuclear weapon, don't build highly enriched fuel. That's a very basic threshold issue. Sixty percent enriched uranium, you know, I'm hardly a nuclear scientist, but I've learned this: you don't need that for any energy production. You don't need it for anything except to have threshold weapons-grade uranium. So I think if they want to show a commitment to not building a nuclear weapon, they would do something meaningful on their enrichment capacity. So far, we haven't seen a long-term commitment to do that. Bogage: There's been reporting that you are leading these talks. Are you leading these talks? Vance: We're certainly involved. I mean, ultimately, the president of the United States is driving things and is issuing direction. And then, you know, we're trying to get the president's mission accomplished as best we can. You know, what the president has said is, you know, look, from the very beginning, we're willing to strike an agreement where the Iranians commit to not rebuilding their nuclear program and take real steps in order to do that, but it takes two to tango, and we're not going to trade words for actions. In other words, the United States is not going to do things for mere promise of actions on the Iranian side. We need to trade actions for actions here, and we'll see what the Iranians do. Bogage: Since we spoke earlier this morning, the New York Times reported there was an Iranian operation in motion in the UK at RAF Fairford, similar to perhaps what the Ukrainians had done in getting drones deep into the country. Do you have any intelligence on that that you're in a position to share? Vance: I'm not going to speak to classified intelligence. Nothing has happened yet. We're very aware that the Iranians are trying to conduct strikes against American assets all over the world. You know, we also have incredibly capable guys on the military side and the intelligence side. So far, nothing has happened. We'll keep praying and working to ensure that it doesn't. Bogage: On munitions stocks, we hear one thing from Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. We hear other things from commanders in the field, but I know you speak to them personally. Have they conveyed concern about munition stocks to you? Vance: I'd be surprised if the commanders in the field were saying something different than what Secretary Hegseth is saying, because obviously they're communicating to him and they're communicating to all of us. I think what is undoubtedly true is that warfare has changed. I mean, you mentioned this Ukrainian attack on a Russian airfield, and you know whatever the reality is, people are using drones and asymmetric capabilities in a totally new way, and that does require a totally new kind of defensive and offensive capability. Do I think that we're far ahead of anybody else in the world? Yeah. Do I think that we always need to be thinking about how to build more? The president, I wouldn't even say laser-focused. I would say he is obsessed with this question of how we stay ahead in terms of military-grade technology. I think that sometimes this munitions conversation gets reinterpreted through a lens of American weakness, when in reality, what the president is just trying to say is, we need to build the weapons of the future, and we need to build enough so that we can properly defend ourselves. Bogage: It would be malpractice, Mr. Vice President, if I didn't ask this. Vance: Go ahead. Bogage: These good people at the rally seem like they want you to run for president. Are you going to run for president, sir? Vance: Man, I've been asked that question a lot. I'm inherently a procrastinator, and I really haven't thought that much about it. We're going to try to win the midterms, get Dan Sullivan elected, which I'm very confident we're going to do, and then, you know, we'll figure it out after that.

item.description: 米ＥＩＡ、27年にかけての原油価格予想を引き上げ Reuters

item.title: 米ＥＩＡ、27年にかけての原油価格予想を引き上げ
item.description: [ニューヨーク ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ニューヨーク ６日 ロイター] - 米エネルギー情報局（ＥＩＡ）が発表した短期エネルギー見通しは、国際指標である北海ブレント原油のスポット価格が２０２６年第４・四半期に平均で１バレル＝約１０５ドルになるとし、前回予測を１４ドル上回るとの見通しを示した。２６年の平均は約９８ドルと予想し、９月に公表した前回予測から８％引き上げた。

供給が回復して在庫が積み上がるのに伴って２７年には平均で８４ドルに低下するものの、前回予測を１０ドル上回るとの見通しを示した。

９月に過去最高値を更新した米国のディーゼル燃料小売価格は１０月に１ガロン＝６ドル超で推移した後、２７年は平均で約４．５０ドルになると予想した。

世界の原油在庫が急速に減少していることや、米国とイスラエルによるイラン攻撃でディーゼル燃料在庫が逼迫した状態が続いていることを背景に、２７年にかけての原油とディーゼル燃料の価格予想を引き上げた。

ＥＩＡは、世界最大級の産油国であるサウジアラビアの主要な輸出ルートとなっている東西を結ぶパイプラインが攻撃されたことは、原油の流通や価格にさらなる混乱が生じるリスクを浮き彫りにしていると指摘。併せてディーゼル燃料の供給が異例の逼迫状態にあることなどを背景に、原油価格は高止まりが続くとの見通しを示した。

６日の原油価格は前日比で２％下落したが、イラン攻撃の後からは３７％超も上がっている。

item.title: IMF reaches staff-level deal with Papua New Guinea, potentially unlocking about $189 million
item.description: The International Monetary Fund said on Tuesday it has reached a staff-level agreement with Papua New Guinea on reviews of its funding facilities, potentially unlocking up to $189 million once approved by the fund's executive board.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund said on Tuesday it has reached a staff-level agreement with Papua New Guinea on reviews of its funding facilities, potentially unlocking up to $189 million once approved by the fund's executive board. IMF staff and Papua New Guinea reached a staff-level agreement on the final reviews of the ECF, EFF and RSF arrangements. If the IMF board approves it, the country would receive about $82 million right away and up to about $107 million in climate financing. Total IMF money paid out would then reach about $1.19 billion. The IMF expects real GDP growth to slow to 3.1% in 2026 from 6.2% in 2025, as LNG output levels off, El Nino hurts farming and mining, and the war in the Middle East pushes up import costs. Headline inflation is expected to rise to 4.8%. The government met all but one quantitative performance criterion and all indicative targets for end-June 2026. It missed its fiscal deficit target in the first half of the year but passed a supplementary budget in September and still aims to keep the 2026 deficit to 1.6 billion Papua New Guinea kina ($345.28 million). ($1 = 4.6339 kinas)

item.title: Former star US bond manager Leech fined by SEC, following guilty plea in 'cherry-picking' case
item.description: Kenneth Leech, the former star bond manager who pleaded guilty to obstructing a US Securities and Exchange Commission probe into alleged "cherry-picking," will pay a $3 million fine to settle the regulator's related civil case, the SEC said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kenneth Leech, the former star bond manager who pleaded guilty to obstructing a US Securities and Exchange Commission probe into alleged "cherry-picking," will pay a $3 million fine to settle the regulator's related civil case, the SEC said on Tuesday. Leech's fine is in addition to the $100 million [USN:L6N42D0OE TEXT:"civil penalty"] that his former employer Western Asset Management Co, or Wamco, agreed to pay in June to resolve SEC civil charges it failed to properly supervise him "Cherry-picking" is the assigning of profitable trades to favored investors and losing trades to other investors. Authorities said Leech's alleged scheme involved more than $600 million and ran from January 2021 to October 2023 Tuesday's settlement requires court approval, and would result in $103 million being returned to harmed investors, the SEC said Leech and Wamco did not admit wrongdoing. Lawyers for Leech did not immediately respond to requests for comment Authorities accused Leech of waiting to see how trades performed on their first day before retroactively allocating them to clients, to boost Wamco revenue and his own compensation Leech allegedly steered better trades to "Macro Opportunities" portfolios that he said reflected his best ideas, and worse trades to "Core" and "Core Plus" portfolios Prosecutors accused Leech of lying during sworn SEC testimony by answering yes when asked if he had "an allocation in mind" when placing trades Leech pleaded guilty in June to one obstruction charge, and could face six to 12 months in prison under recommended federal sentencing guidelines. Prosecutors dropped four fraud charges Wamco is part of Franklin Resources (BEN.N) , whose brands include Franklin Templeton

item.description: ＡＭＤ、27年に半導体供給大幅増へ ＡＩ需要に対応 Reuters

item.title: ＡＭＤ、27年に半導体供給大幅増へ ＡＩ需要に対応
item.description:
Wen-Yee Lee
[台北 ６日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手ＡＭＤのリサ・スー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は６日、人...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＭＤ、27年に半導体供給大幅増へ　ＡＩ需要に対応 7:43 配信

カナダ・バンクーバーで５月に開催されたデジタル見本市に設けられたＡＭＤのブース。 REUTERS/Chris Helgren

Wen-Yee Lee

[台北 ６日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手ＡＭＤのリサ・スー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は６日、人工知能（ＡＩ）向け需要の急拡大に対応するため、２０２７年に半導体供給を大幅に増やす計画を明らかにした。

ＡＩ向け画像処理半導体でエヌビディアの最大の競合であるＡＭＤは、ＡＩ半導体事業を急速に拡大している。ＡＩ関連株の上昇を背景に、時価総額は最近１兆ドルを突破した。

スー氏は台北で記者団に「２０２６年を通じて供給を増やすことができており、２７年には供給を大幅に拡大する」と述べた。

今回の台湾訪問の目的の一つは、拡大するＡＩ需要に対応できるよう、ＡＭＤのサプライチェーンで中央演算処理装置（ＣＰＵ）と画像処理半導体（ＧＰＵ）の増産体制を確保することだと説明した。現地パートナーとの協議の一環として、鴻海精密工業と既に面会したほか、台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）とも面会する予定だ。

スー氏は同日の韓国訪問を前に、十分な供給を確保するためメモリー半導体メーカーとも緊密に連携していると述べた。韓国にはメモリー大手のサムスン電子とＳＫハイニックスが本拠を置く。

ＴＳＭＣが米テキサス州への投資の可能性についてＡＭＤと協議したかとの質問には直接回答しなかったが、旺盛な需要に対応するには追加の先端ウエハー生産能力が必要になると指摘。

「今後数年間は極めて高い需要がある。非常に高い需要が見込まれるため、より多くの先端ウエハー生産能力が必要だ」とし、ＡＭＤは現在、３─５年先を見据えて計画を立てていると述べた。

ロイターは先週、ＴＳＭＣがテキサス州への投資を検討していると報じた。

スー氏はまた、ＡＩは「世界にとって非常に有益」になり得るとする一方、企業はリスクを常に意識し、ＡＩの安全性について協力する必要があると警告した。

ＡＩや超知能が進歩する中で、大手テクノロジー企業間の連携が重要になるとし、先週開かれたトランプ米大統領とテクノロジー企業幹部によるＡＩサミットは重要な一歩だったと述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：空前のＡＩ投資、相応の経済効果実現へなお高いハードル アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か 最終更新: 10/7(水) 7:43 ロイター

item.title: US forecasts hurricane later this week in Gulf of Mexico
item.description: US forecasters said on Tuesday a storm forming in the Gulf of Mexico and speeding towards Louisiana and Mississippi would become the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026 within two days.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Saha, Erwin Seba
item.content:encoded: US forecasters said on Tuesday a storm forming in the Gulf of Mexico and speeding towards Louisiana and Mississippi would become the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026 within two days. Currently named Tropical Depression Nine, the cyclone would be at tropical storm strength by early Wednesday, the National Hurricane Center said. "The depression is expected to pass to the north of the Yucatan Peninsula on Thursday, and approach the US northern Gulf Coast on Friday," the Hurricane Center said in a statement. The storm is forecast to pass through offshore areas with oil and gas [USN:L1N45S13L TEXT:"production facilities"] and onshore areas with major refineries. Any impact could further tighten energy markets and drive up gasoline and diesel prices already soaring due to the US-Israeli war with Iran. The offshore areas in the Gulf in the storm's path produce 15% of US crude oil and 5% of the country's natural gas. In the forecast landfall area the storm could affect six refineries operated by Shell (SHEL.L) , Valero Energy (VLO.N) , Marathon (MPC.N) , PBF Energy (PBF.N) , and [USN:L1N45S12V TEXT:"Chevron"] (CVX.N) . Refineries in US Gulf states account for about 50% of the national capacity of 18.2 million barrels per day (bpd).

item.title: Teammates and fans bid emotional farewell to Messi ahead of Argentina finale
item.description: From former and current team mates to tearful fans outside the Monumental stadium, tributes poured in for Argentine great Lionel Messi on Tuesday as the country prepared to bid farewell to their captain in his final international appearance.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: From former and current team mates to tearful fans outside the Monumental stadium, tributes poured in for Argentine great Lionel Messi on Tuesday as the country prepared to bid [USN:L6N45N1BV TEXT:"farewell"] to their captain in his final international appearance. Brazil's Neymar, Messi's former Barcelona and Paris St Germain teammate and longtime friend, said the whole world should be grateful for what the Argentine had given the sport. "It's not only Argentina that thanks you, the world thanks you for everything you have done for football," Neymar wrote on Instagram, hours before Messi was due to play his 208th and final game for Argentina against Benin. "Thank you for making me love football even more. It was an honour for me to have played against you and even more so to make history alongside you." For Rodrigo De Paul, Messi's close friend and Argentina team mate who also plays alongside him at Inter Miami, the impact went far beyond football. "He made me grow not only as a footballer, but also as a person. I became a better person, a better human being, a better athlete, a better father and a better friend," De Paul said in a farewell message released on Tuesday. "I want to tell him that I love him. He knows that he is my brother and that he has an enormous heart." Former Argentina teammate Angel Di Maria said it was a day nobody had wanted to come. "Seeing him with so much happiness, and that tranquillity of knowing that he gave everything he had, is what makes us all happy," Di Maria said. "It will be a very special day for everyone. I thank him for life." FANS SAY GOODBYE In Buenos Aires, fans flocking to the Monumental stadium for the Argentina v Benin friendly expressed a mixture of gratitude and sadness. "I cried because I was able to come and see Messi in his last game, and also because of the sadness of knowing that he won't be here anymore," 19-year-old Jose Garracedo told Reuters TV. "He fought for this shirt ... everything that was demanded of him. He knew how to stay the course, enjoy it and keep saying that he was going to fight for this." For Isaias Zenas, a 27-year-old medical student, Messi's importance extended beyond football. "The last joys we have had as an Argentine people, we owe to him," he said. "All the cups he brought us, with the country in a bad economic situation, people who are struggling have their refuge in football. How could we not come here at this moment to say goodbye to him?" Messi, who helped Argentina win the World Cup and two Copa America titles, enters the game with a national-record 125 goals and 68 assists for his country. Before the final goodbye, he offered a simple message of his own. "I leave in peace. I gave everything."

item.title: 米北東部選出の民主党議員、暖房油高騰で政権に対応要求
item.description:
Jarrett Renshaw
[６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jarrett Renshaw

[６日 ロイター] - 米北東部選出の民主党議員グループは、イランとの戦争やトランプ政権の政策によって暖房用燃料油の価格が高騰しているとして、ライト・エネルギー長官に価格引き下げに向けた対応を求めた。ロイターが６日に書簡を確認した。１１月の中間選挙が迫り、エネルギー高騰問題がトランプ米政権への強い政治的圧力となっている構図が鮮明になった。

マサチューセッツ州選出のエリザベス・ウォーレン上院議員が主導するグループが記した５日付の書簡によると、暖房油価格は紛争前と比べ約６０％上昇しており、各家庭が今冬の暖房に支払う費用は約６００ドル増える恐れが出ている。暖房油とディーゼル油は同じ精製過程から生産されるため、供給逼迫やディーゼル価格の上昇は暖房油価格の押し上げ要因となる。北東部ニューイングランド地方では住宅の約３分の１が暖房油を使用しており、一部の州ではその割合が約半数に達する。

ディーゼル価格は１ガロン当たり６ドルを突破。冬を控え、農業やトラック輸送に欠かせないディーゼルの供給を増やし、価格を引き下げるため、政権は対応を急いでいる。

トランプ大統領は５日、連邦道路税が免除される赤色に着色されたディーゼル油について、使用目的にかかわらず誰でも非課税で購入できるよう対象を拡大する大統領令に署名。政権は欧州の同盟国に対し、緊急用ディーゼル備蓄の放出も要請しているほか、米国からのディーゼル輸出を禁止する可能性も示している。主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は先週、原油とディーゼル計１億バレルを備蓄から放出することで合意した。

こうした中で民主党議員グループは書簡で、ホルムズ海峡の閉鎖や燃料在庫の低水準、旺盛な輸出が暖房油とディーゼルの価格上昇につながっていると指摘。ライト氏に対し、イランとの戦争の即時終結を支持するとともに、エネルギー支援策を復活させ、クリーンエネルギーや送電網整備に対する削減措置を撤回するよう求めた。

暖房費の高騰は、北東部で激戦が予想される２つの上院選にも影響を及ぼしている。メーン州では共和党のスーザン・コリンズ上院議員が厳しい再選選挙に直面しているだけでなく、ニューハンプシャー州では空席となる上院議席を巡り、民主党のクリス・パパス氏と共和党のジョン・スヌヌ氏が接戦を繰り広げ、超党派の選挙分析機関の見立てでは同州の情勢は「互角」だ。

コリンズ氏とメーン州選出の無所属アンガス・キング上院議員はトランプ氏に対し、北東部家庭用暖房油備蓄の放出を求めている。同備蓄は約１００万バレルあり、２０１２年のハリケーン「サンディ」以来、使用されていない。

item.title: In interview, US Vice President Vance says Iran must cut enrichment to end war
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance said in an exclusive interview with Reuters that Iran must make a “meaningful” reduction in its nuclear enrichment capacity to satisfy US demands and end the countries’ seven-month war, even as Washington was unsure how Tehran makes decisions in negotiations.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Bogage
item.content:encoded: US Vice President JD Vance said in an exclusive interview with Reuters that Iran must make a “meaningful” reduction in its nuclear enrichment capacity to satisfy US demands and end the countries’ seven-month war, even as Washington was unsure how Tehran makes decisions in negotiations. Vance, a longtime skeptic of US involvement in foreign wars, has [USN:L8N42P1PE TEXT:"taken a leading role in negotiating a settlement"] to the conflict and brokered a provisional peace agreement in June that quickly fell apart. The war has jolted global energy markets and become a political liability for President Donald Trump and fellow Republicans ahead of November midterm elections. Speaking on Monday after a campaign trip in Alaska, Vance said any agreement would require Iran to reduce its nuclear enrichment capacity, rather than offer assurances of future nuclear drawdowns. "If you don't want a nuclear weapon, then why do you need 60% enriched fuel? And if you want to show commitment to not building a nuclear weapon, don't build highly enriched fuel. That's a very basic threshold issue," Vance said. "I think if they want to show a commitment to not building a nuclear weapon, they would do something meaningful on their enrichment capacity." Iran and the US have exchanged proposals in recent weeks aimed at ending the war and reopening the Strait of Hormuz, a vital global energy shipping route. Trump rejected Tehran's latest offer and has warned that military operations could intensify after the midterms. Vance said the US remained open to an agreement but would require concrete Iranian nuclear concessions. "We're not going to trade words for actions," Vance said. UNCLEAR HOW IRAN MAKES DECISIONS: VANCE Complicating matters, Vance said Washington is uncertain who makes decisions in Tehran. Vance said the US was in talks with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi. But it was unclear how much authority they wield within Iran's power structure, he said, after joint US-Israeli strikes at the start of the war killed Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. "One of the things we picked up on is it's not totally clear how their country makes decisions," Vance said. Separately, Trump said on Tuesday his "[USN:S0N44P02O TEXT:"biggest problem"]" is no one knows who is running Iran. Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson said on Sunday that US officials are well aware of who their Iranian counterparts are and how Iran's decision-making system works. "The problem is actually the opposite: it lies in the contradictory positions and mixed messaging from US officials," Esmaeil Baghaei told a weekly press conference. Vance told Reuters he has held personal conversations with field commanders to gauge battlefield conditions. He dismissed concerns over critical munitions shortages and added that while Iranian troops are periodically able to strike commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz, they are largely unable to prevent energy exports through the waterway. The war — [USN:L6N4530XO TEXT:"and its $3 billion monthly price tag"] — has become a key issue on the campaign trail. Higher energy prices have put Trump and Republicans on the defensive in competitive states that will decide control of Congress. Vance has sought to temper criticism of Trump’s handling of the conflict, telling voters they should not let that issue keep them from backing Republicans in next month's elections. In Alaska, [USN:L6N45R01A TEXT:"Vance rallied for Republican Senator Dan Sullivan"], who is locked in a tight reelection battle with Democratic challenger Mary Peltola. Trump carried Alaska by 13 percentage points in 2024, but rising everyday costs have put the state in play. Before speaking with Reuters, Vance focused much of his speech on affordability concerns, especially around energy. Alaska's remote locale makes consumer goods more expensive, and energy production is a key industry. Rally attendees roared when Sullivan nearly introduced Vance as the president of the US, rather than the vice president. Vance is seen as a leading Republican contender to succeed Trump in the White House. Vance told Reuters afterward that he had not decided whether to seek the presidency in 2028. "I'm inherently a procrastinator," he said. "I really haven't thought about it much."

item.title: 韓国からの輸出がロシア燃料危機緩和に寄与＝ウクライナ - Reuters
item.description: 韓国からの輸出がロシア燃料危機緩和に寄与＝ウクライナ Reuters

item.title: 韓国からの輸出がロシア燃料危機緩和に寄与＝ウクライナ
item.description: [ロンドン／ソウル ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ロンドン／ソウル ６日 ロイター] - ウクライナのブラシウク大統領顧問（制裁政策担当）は６日、ロシアが７─８月に韓国の港から１７万６０００トン超の石油製品を輸入し、ウクライナによるロシア製油所へのドローン（無人機）攻撃で生じた燃料危機の影響が緩和されたと述べた。

韓国からの供給は８月のロシアの燃料輸入の３１％を占めたという。同氏は西側の制裁対象タンカーを含む船舶が輸送に使われたとする報道に基づくとした。

ブラシウク氏は「これらの輸送は、ウクライナによるロシア製油所への攻撃で処理量が減少し、ロシア国内で燃料不足が生じていたタイミングで始まった」とフェイスブックに投稿した。

韓国とウクライナは、ゼレンスキー大統領が９月に北朝鮮兵捕虜２人の韓国への移送を公表したことをきっかけに、外交上の対立を深めている。

ブラシウク氏は「入手可能なデータ」や「報道」を根拠に挙げ、「事実上、韓国からの輸入はロシアが自国の精製能力を失った影響を補う助けとなった」と述べた。

英紙ガーディアンは６日、港湾記録と船舶追跡データを分析した結果、問題の石油製品が韓国の港湾でタンカー７隻に積み込まれたことが判明したとし、そのうち数隻は英国と欧州連合（ＥＵ）の制裁対象となっていると報じた。

ブラシウク氏が示した数量は、ガーディアンの報道と同じだった。

韓国外務省はガーディアンの記事に対し、「韓国政府は、ウクライナでの戦争を終結させ、平和的な復興を実現するための国際的な取り組みを支持し、積極的に参加している」と表明した。

item.title: SpaceX seeks $40 billion financing led by Apollo to buy Nvidia chips, FT reports
item.description: SpaceX plans to raise $40 billion, led by asset manager Apollo Global Management , for purchasing Nvidia AI chips, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: SpaceX (SPCX.O) plans to raise $40 billion, led by asset manager Apollo Global Management (APO.N) , for purchasing Nvidia (NVDA.O) AI chips, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter. The Elon Musk-led company is looking to raise about $10 billion in bank loans and $30 billion in investment-grade debt for the chip order, the report said. The proposed funding underscores the enormous capital requirement of the AI boom, as tech companies race to secure advanced processors and build out the computing infrastructure needed to support AI development. Morgan Stanley [USN:L1N45G0W4 TEXT:"estimates"] AI infrastructure will require $1.5 trillion in external financing by 2028, even as lenders and investors grow more cautious about funding the industry's expansion. Apollo is expected to lead the SpaceX deal and help place the debt with a broad range of investors, with bond fund Pimco among a small group of lenders in talks to provide financing, the newspaper reported, adding that the transaction is expected to close in 2027. Shares of the rocket and spacecraft manufacturer fell 1% in extended trading after the report, while Nvidia's stock rose 0.5%. While SpaceX, Apollo and Nvidia did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment, Pimco declined to comment. Musk, who took SpaceX public in June in a record $86 billion [USN:L4N42N1FH TEXT:"IPO"], had said last month that xAI's Colossus 2 data center could more than double the number of Nvidia chips it uses by December. The company plans to use Nvidia hardware [USN:L4N4411XL TEXT:"exclusively"] to build its data centers, Musk said. Nvidia, the dominant supplier of AI processors, in August [USN:L4N44719P TEXT:"partnered with"] Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR on financing platforms intended to mobilize more than $500 billion for AI infrastructure projects.

item.title: Trump says nobody knows who is running Iran - Reuters
item.description: Trump says nobody knows who is running Iran Reuters

item.title: Trump says nobody knows who is running Iran
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that nobody knew who was running Iran during the US-Israeli war with Iran,now in its eighth month.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery, Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that nobody knew who was running Iran during the US-Israeli war with Iran, now in its eighth month. QUOTES AND DETAILS: "Their leaders are gone, their second group of leaders are gone, and the biggest problem I have is nobody knows who the hell is running the country," Trump said. Iran's foreign ministry spokesman said on Sunday Washington knows very well who their counterpart is in Iran and how the decision-making system in Iran works. "The problem is actually the opposite: it lies in the contradictory positions and mixed messaging from US officials," Esmaeil Baghaei said in a news conference. Iran's [USN:L1N436014 TEXT:"Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei"] was killed on the first day of the US-Israeli war on Iran, which began on February 28. His son, Mojtaba Khamenei, succeeded him but has not been seen in public since he was injured in the same strike that killed his father. Iran responded with its own strikes on Israel and Gulf states that host US bases. US-Israeli strikes on Iran and Israeli attacks on Lebanon have [USN:L1N3ZR14Q TEXT:"killed thousands"] and [USN:L6N3ZY0Q0 TEXT:"displaced millions"]. Fuel prices that have risen in response to the war are also a risk to Trump's Republican Party ahead of the November US midterm elections in which control of Congress is at stake. Trump, whose approval rating has held at a record low amid concerns of high cost of living spurred by soaring gasoline and diesel prices, has offered [USN:L4N4061X8 TEXT:"shifting timelines and goals"] for the war.

item.title: Grupo Primo faz fusão com Oikos Wealth Management
item.description: O Grupo Primo anunciou nesta terça-feira fusão com a gestora de fortunas Oikos Wealth Management, elevando o total de recursos sob administração da empresa para R$34 bilhões.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Grupo Primo anunciou nesta terça-feira fusão com a gestora de fortunas Oikos Wealth Management, elevando o total de recursos sob administração da empresa para R$34 bilhões. O grupo tem meta de alcançar R$100 bilhões sob gestão até 2028 e com a aquisição, a empresa passa a contar com os sócios da Oikos, Fernanda Raimo, Rafael Medeiros, Eduardo Ruske e Renato Mendes, segundo comunicado à imprensa. Com o negócio, o grupo ingressa no mercado de clientes "private", com patrimônio entre R$20 milhões e R$100 milhões, e acima disso, segundo o documento, que não informa o volume de recursos administrados pela companhia antes da operação. "Embora tenhamos a meta de R$100 bilhões até 2028, não buscamos apenas ativos sob gestão. Buscamos sócios, capital humano de altíssimo nível, com currículo e cultura compatíveis... A Oikos é exatamente isso", afirmou o presidente-executivo do Grupo Primo, Fernando Vasconcellos, no comunicado.

item.title: Why Gas Flares Keep Burning Despite Big Oil’s 2030 Pledges

Oil giants including ExxonMobil, Occidental Petroleum and others have pledged to reduce or eliminate the flaring practice, but a new investigation by Bloomberg News and The Examination found persistent flames at sites tied to companies participating in the World Bank’s Zero Routine Flaring initiative. For more, we speak with Ben Elgin, Bloomberg News ESG Reporter & Will Evans, Senior Reporter for The Examination. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: BOJ's dovish dissenter signals support for future rate hikes
item.description: The Bank of Japan's new policymaker Ayano Sato said she supports the idea of raising interest rates in several stages, Kyodo news agency reported on Wednesday, highlighting awareness even among dovish board members of the need to combat inflation risks.
item.dc:creator: Leika Kihara
item.content:encoded: The Bank of Japan's new policymaker Ayano Sato said she supports the idea of raising interest rates in several stages, Kyodo news agency reported on Wednesday, highlighting awareness even among dovish board members of the need to combat inflation risks. Appointed by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, who favours looser monetary policy, Sato was one of two dissenters to the BOJ's decision to raise interest rates in [USN:L1N459138 TEXT:"September"]. She joined the nine-member board in June. In the interview with Kyodo, Sato said she decided to vote against last month's rate hike because consumption lacked momentum and underlying inflation was not picking up pace. "I support the idea that interest rates should be adjusted in stages, as current financial conditions are accommodative," Sato was quoted as saying, adding that the appropriate timing of future rate hikes would depend on developments in consumption and income. Sato also said there should not be any pre-set pace for future rate hikes, according to Kyodo. Risks to the price outlook were "somewhat skewed to the upside" due to rising crude oil prices linked to the Middle East conflict, Sato said. INFLATION APPROACHING 2% Along with Toichiro Asada, another newcomer appointed by Takaichi, Sato has been seen by markets as among doves on the nine-member board who could continue to vote against rate hikes. Their dissents in September pushed down the yen as market players interpreted the move as a sign the BOJ's rate-hike plans would continue to face opposition from Takaichi's administration. Sato told Kyodo that BOJ rate hikes could contribute to achieving sustained economic growth. The central bank would set policy independently, but in a way that "eventually aligns with the administration's proactive fiscal policy," she said. After spending years treading cautiously in policy normalisation, the BOJ picked up pace in raising rates by hiking in June and September as the Iran war-induced energy shock added to price pressures from rising import costs via a weak yen. Upon hiking rates to a 31-year high of 1.25% in September, Governor Kazuo Ueda said the central bank had entered a phase focused on preventing underlying inflation from overshooting its target, raising the prospect of tighter policy. While the BOJ may pause in October, it is likely to drop hawkish hints that would reinforce dominant market expectations of a December hike, [USN:L4N45S011 TEXT:"sources have told Reuters"]. In a separate interview with the daily Asahi newspaper, Sato said underlying inflation was approaching the BOJ's 2% target, adding that her views on monetary policy were "not that different from many others in the board."

item.title: C.H. Robinson CEO sees more freight broker consolidation as diesel costs bite
item.description: C.H. Robinson Worldwide CEO Dave Bozeman expects more consolidation among US freight brokers as higher diesel prices squeeze smaller players, he told Reuters, a day after the company agreed to buy RXO for $5.8 billion.
item.dc:creator: Apratim Sarkar
item.content:encoded: C.H. Robinson Worldwide (CHRW.O) CEO Dave Bozeman expects more consolidation among US freight brokers as higher diesel prices squeeze smaller players, he told Reuters, a day after the company agreed to buy RXO (RXO.N) for [USN:L4N45R0MP TEXT:"$5.8 billion"]. "We said we would be the consolidator," Bozeman said in an interview on Tuesday, citing the growing importance of scale and leverage. RXO fits C.H. Robinson's target profile, with strong gross margins and about $6.5 billion in business but weak operating margins. The company plans to lift RXO's margins to its own levels within two years, while adding last-mile and expedited services. A rise in diesel prices has pushed small carriers to a "stress point," forcing some capacity out of the market, Bozeman said, adding that freight rates should remain elevated into the holiday season. Asset-light C.H. Robinson is largely insulated, with diesel costs "very, very manageable," he said. Higher fuel and insurance costs will ultimately be passed on to shippers and consumers. The U.S. Energy Information Administration on Tuesday [USN:L6N45S116 TEXT:"raised"] its oil price forecasts for this year and next as global inventories fall rapidly and diesel markets remain tight amid the Iran war.

item.title: 世界の石油在庫、供給混乱への備えほぼ枯渇＝業界幹部 - Reuters
item.description: 世界の石油在庫、供給混乱への備えほぼ枯渇＝業界幹部 Reuters

item.title: 世界の石油在庫、供給混乱への備えほぼ枯渇＝業界幹部
item.description:
Robert Harvey Stephanie Kelly Shadia Nasralla
[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Robert Harvey　Stephanie Kelly　Shadia Nasralla

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - 世界市場に供給できる石油在庫が底を突きつつあり、市場の脆弱性が高まり、価格に上昇圧力がかかっている。業界幹部らが今週、ロンドンで開かれた会議で指摘した。

中東とウクライナでの戦争により、世界の石油市場は今年、前例のない供給混乱に直面している。各国政府とエネルギー企業は需給逼迫を和らげるため、在庫を取り崩してきた。

サウジアラビアの国有石油会社サウジアラムコのアミン・ナセル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、エネルギー・インテリジェンス・フォーラムで「現在残っている商業在庫は６０億バレルを下回り、その大半は実質的に利用できないため、供給体制はすでに緊張にさらされている」と述べた。

ナセル氏は、今年の中東危機発生以降、主に陸上の商業在庫から１０億バレルを超える石油が放出されたとし、これが残された最後の主要な対応手段だったと指摘した。

国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）は、高騰するディーゼル燃料（軽油）価格の緩和に向け、原油とディーゼル燃料計１億バレルを放出する準備を進めている。ただ、この中に３月に決定された記録的な第１弾の４億バレル放出のうちまだ市場に供給されていない分が含まれるかどうかは明らかでない。

ナセル氏はＩＥＡの決定について「多くの交渉を要したが、放出量は１億バレルだ」と述べた。「在庫は逼迫した水準に近づいている。利用できるのは１０％以下にすぎず、だからこそ１億バレル（の放出）にも苦労している」と語った。

ＩＥＡによると、世界の石油需要は日量約１億０２００万バレル。

米石油大手シェブロンのマイク・ワースＣＥＯは６日、石油市場のバッファーが失われたことで市場の脆弱性が高まり、石油価格の下値も切り上がったと述べた。

業界幹部らは５日、世界需要を満たしながら在庫を積み増すには数年かかる可能性があるため、石油市場の混乱は来年以降も続くとの見通しを示した。

item.title: Michigan TE apologizes for leaked texts criticizing OC
item.description: Michigan tight end Zack Marshall posted an apology online Tuesday after making what he called "inappropriate comments" about his offensive coordinator in a group text that leaked.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Michigan tight end Zack Marshall posted an apology online Tuesday after making what he called "inappropriate comments" about his offensive coordinator in a group text that leaked. The messages, posted to X on Monday by the account College Transfer Portal, showed Marshall criticizing coordinator Jason Beck and the Wolverines' offense. "Last weekend, in the hours after we lost, I made some inappropriate comments that I regret," Marshall wrote in a social media post Tuesday. "The game is won and lost as a team, and I pointed fingers instead of taking accountability. I let my frustrations speak for me in an emotional moment. I apologize to my teammates and coaches for the unnecessary drama that this has caused." A spokesperson for the Michigan athletic department told ESPN that coaches have discussed the situation with Marshall. Marshall, who has not recorded a reception this season, told the other members of the group chat following the Wolverines' 20-14 loss to Minnesota on Saturday that Beck "had a meeting (with) all the (tight ends) and told us none of us are valuable to this offense." He referenced former head coach Sherrone Moore -- fired last December after an investigation determined he had an inappropriate relationship with a staffer -- and wrote Beck was "worse than Sherrone (minus the findings and other evidence)." "Basically our offense sucks cause if you blitz us we have no answers," Marshall also wrote. "... Also Beck tells (quarterback) Bryce (Underwood) where to go on every play and it gets strapped. Bryce is a good qb, Beck is a problem." Michigan is 3-2 and has started its Big Ten schedule with consecutive losses to Iowa and Minnesota, in which the Wolverines put up 19 and 14 points, respectively. Underwood, a former five-star recruit, has taken much of the blame as he has thrown four interceptions with a 59.3 percent completion rate. Beck, 46, is in his first season at Michigan as its offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach after following new head coach Kyle Whittingham from Utah, where he held the same positions. He has previously coached offense and quarterbacks at New Mexico (2024) and Syracuse (2022-23). Marshall, a senior, had 16 receptions for 199 yards and one touchdown in 2025. --Field Level Media

item.title: Coreia do Norte adverte EUA sobre Taiwan, enquanto Kim promete apoio à Rússia
item.description: A Coreia do Norte criticou os Estados Unidos por suas vendas de armas e apoio militar a Taiwan, acusando Washington de alimentar as tensões no Estreito de Taiwan, informou a agência de notícias estatal KCNA na quarta-feira (horário local).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Coreia do Norte criticou os Estados Unidos por suas vendas de armas e apoio militar a Taiwan, acusando Washington de alimentar as tensões no Estreito de Taiwan, informou a agência de notícias estatal KCNA na quarta-feira (horário local). Um comentário da KCNA, citando o analista norte-coreano de assuntos internacionais Kim Myong Chol, afirmou que a política dos EUA em relação a Taiwan está prejudicando a paz e a estabilidade na região. O comentário condenou a presença de caças vendidos pelos EUA em Taiwan, afirmando que os EUA “devem pensar duas vezes se estão prontos para entrar em confronto direto com a poderosa potência nacional da República Popular da China pela segurança de Taiwan e se serão capazes de lidar com as consequências disso”. Os dois primeiros de um lote de 66 novos caças F-16V Block 70 encomendados em 2019 chegaram a Taiwan na semana passada, enquanto Taiwan enfrenta uma crescente ameaça militar de Pequim, que reivindica a ilha governada democraticamente como seu próprio território. Enquanto isso, o líder norte-coreano Kim Jong Un prometeu apoio contínuo à Rússia e aos seus esforços de guerra em uma mensagem de aniversário ao presidente Vladimir Putin, informou a KCNA na quarta-feira. Kim afirmou que Pyongyang continuaria a ampliar a cooperação no âmbito da parceria estratégica abrangente entre os países, dizendo estar convencido de que a “guerra sagrada pela justiça” da Rússia para defender sua soberania, interesses de segurança e integridade territorial terminaria em vitória, informou a KCNA. A mensagem não mencionou explicitamente a guerra da Rússia na Ucrânia. A Coreia do Norte enviou cerca de 14.000 a 15.000 soldados para apoiar a guerra da Rússia na Ucrânia desde 2024, segundo estimativas ucranianas e sul-coreanas. A Coreia do Norte e a Rússia fortaleceram significativamente seus laços desde que Putin e Kim assinaram um pacto de defesa mútua em junho de 2024.

item.content:encoded:
マーベル、28年度売上高200億ドル見込む　ＡＩ向けカスタム半導体がけん引 7:03 配信

１0月６日、米ニューヨークで開催されたマーベル・テクノロジーの投資家向け説明会。 REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz

Prathik Jayaprakash　Anhata Rooprai　Max A. Cherney

[６日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手マーベル・テクノロジー が６日発表した２０２８会計年度の売上高見通しは約２００億ドルと、ＬＳＥＧがまとめた市場予想の１８２億ドルを上回った。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資の拡大を背景に、データセンター向けカスタム半導体の需要が伸びると見込む。

クリス・クープマンズ社長兼最高執行責任者（ＣＯＯ）はインタビューで「会社をこの軌道に乗せ、技術面でリーダーになるまでには長い時間がかかった。われわれには約束したことを実行してきた実績がある」と語った。

マーベルは２１年、データセンター向けに特化して設計するカスタム半導体やクラウド最適化半導体を軸とする戦略を打ち出した。その後ＡＩインフラ投資拡大の恩恵を受けており、２９会計年度のカスタム半導体事業の売上高について、従来の１００億ドルから１２０億ドルに目標を引き上げた。

大手テクノロジー企業がエヌビディア 製半導体への依存を減らすためにＡＩ向け半導体の自社開発を進める中、マーベルのカスタム半導体事業は主要な成長の柱となっている。それに伴って同社の株価は今年に入って３倍超に上昇した。

さらに中長期目標としてマーベルが示した３１会計年度売上高見通しは７００億－９００億ドルだった。レンジの中央値となる８００億ドルは、ビジブル・アルファがまとめたアナリスト４人の市場予想４６８億５０００万ドルを大幅に上回っている。

item.title: Dimensional PM on IPO Pipeline, Concentration Risks
item.description: Joel Schneider, Dimensional’s Deputy Head of Portfolio Management for North America, says well-founded IPOs can attract strong interest regardless of broader market conditions, but investors should look beyond the initial pop: IPOs have historically tended to underperform the market afterward, making fundamentals and entry timing important. He notes that index providers add new listings on different schedules, so index-fund investors effectively delegate that decision to an index committee. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Regulador brasileño aplaza la decisión sobre el contrato eléctrico de Enel en São Paulo
item.description: El regulador energético brasileño ANEEL aplazó el martes su decisión sobre si recomendar la rescisión anticipada de la licencia de la empresa italiana Enel para distribuir electricidad en el área metropolitana de São Paulo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El regulador energético brasileño ANEEL aplazó el martes su decisión sobre si recomendar la rescisión anticipada de la licencia de la empresa italiana Enel (ENEI.MI) para distribuir electricidad en el área metropolitana de São Paulo. La decisión se pospuso después de que uno de los consejeros de la ANEEL solicitara más tiempo para examinar el caso Dos de los cinco miembros del consejo de administración habían emitido su voto, ambos a favor de recomendar al Ministerio de Minas y Energía de Brasil la rescisión del contrato antes de su fecha de vencimiento en 2028 Los dos consejeros afirmaron que recomendar la rescisión es el último recurso disponible para la ANEEL, después de que los acuerdos de mejora del rendimiento y las multas resultaran insuficientes Enel está en el punto de mira en Brasil después de que unas condiciones meteorológicas extremas dejaran sin electricidad a millones de hogares y empresas entre 2023 y 2025 en São Paulo La empresa afirma que el procedimiento se centra en un único fenómeno meteorológico ocurrido en 2025 y no tiene en cuenta las mejoras realizadas durante los últimos dos años y medio La empresa también cuestiona algunos aspectos de la metodología de la ANEEL para calcular los tiempos de interrupción del servicio y de reconexión de los clientes

item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（6日）Ｓ＆Ｐ５００とナスダックが最高値更新、ユーロ上昇、利回り低下 7:00 配信

9月29日、ニューヨーク証券取引所。 REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

＜為替＞ ニューヨーク外為市場ではユーロが上昇し、１日としては７週間ぶりの大幅な上昇を記録する見通し。フランス国債利回りの低下を受け、ユーロ圏債市場の緊張に対する懸念が和らいだ。

ユーロ／ドルは０．３５％高の１．１２６ドル。１日としては８月１９日以来の大幅高となる見通し。前日の取引では、約１年５カ月ぶりの安値を付ける場面もあった。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．３２％安の１０１．８３。１日の下げとしては９月３日以来最大となる見込み。

原油相場の落ち着きを背景に、仏１０年債利回りは６日の取引で低下。同債利回りはここ数週間で急上昇し、指標となる独債との利回り格差は月初に２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の最大水準に拡大していた。

ポンド／ドルは１週間ぶりの高値となる１．３２８３ドルを付けた後、終盤の取引では０．４２％高の１．３２７５ドル。ポンドも１日としては８月１９日以来の大幅高となる勢い。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 米金融・債券市場では国債利回りが低下した。前日の取引で国債が売り込まれた反動で買戻しが入った。３年債入札が堅調だったことも利回り低下に寄与した。市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策の行方を見極めようと、来週発表されるインフレ指標が注目されている。

前日の取引では、高金利環境の長期化見通しが織り込まれたことで１０年債と３０年債の利回りが約２４年ぶりの水準に上昇。ＦＨＮフィナンシャル（シカゴ）のマクロストラテジスト、ウィル・コンパーノール氏は、この日は「ファンダメンタルズ（基礎的要件）が変化する前に一服する動きが出た」と指摘。「市場では次の大きな材料を見極める動きが出ている」とし、「次の材料が卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）になるのか、消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）になるのかは分からないが、利回りはすでに高水準にあり、さらに上昇するにはその動きを正当化するより説得力のある材料が必要になる」と述べた。

市場関係者によると、この日はユーロ圏の国債利回りが低下したことも米国債利回りの低下に寄与した。特に、懸念の的になっていたフランス国債利回りが低下したことが米国債市場にも波及したとしている。

終盤の取引で１０年債利回りは前日比４．２ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の５．２６９％。３０年債利回りは２．２ｂｐ低下の５．６４２％。

２年債利回りは４．４ｂｐ低下の４．７８９％。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 米国株式市場は続伸。幅広い銘柄が買われ、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が最高値を更新して引けた。原油価格が落ち着き、米国債利回りも低下したことで、ここ数週間に投資家を悩ませてきた懸念が和らぎ、市場の関心は間近に迫った第３・四半期決算発表シーズンに向かった。

ダウ工業株３０種は８月５日に付けた終値での最高値を５％余り下回っている。

ウェルスパイア・アドバイザーズのシニアバイスプレジデント、オリバー・パーシェ氏は、原油価格が安定または下落すると「エネルギー価格高騰によるインフレへの不安が和らぐため利回りが低下し、それが株価の上昇を後押しする」と指摘。「ここ数週間の市場はこうした構図で動いてきた」と述べた。

超大型株「マグニフィセント・セブン」のうち６銘柄が上昇し、相場を押し上げた。一方、小型株指数のラッセル２０００はアンダーパフォームした。

人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株への買いは依然として健在で、フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（ＳＯＸ指数）も上昇した。ＡＩ関連インフラへの支出は貿易統計にも表れ、８月の資本財輸入は４．４％増加した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 米長期金利の上昇一服やドル安を背景に、金相場は上昇した。投資家は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の９月会合議事要旨の公表を注視している。

中心限月１２月物の清算値は前日比０．７％高の１オンス＝４１８７．１０ドル。１８１２ＧＭＴ（日本時間７日午前３時１２分）現在、現物価格は０．７％高の１オンス＝４１６８．３３ドル。

米１０年債利回りは前日に２０年以上ぶりの高水準まで上昇した後、やや低下。ドルも１年ぶり高値から下落し、他通貨保有者にとって金が割安となった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 米国時間の原油先物は序盤の下げを取り戻し、ほぼ横ばいで終了した。中東からの原油輸出の増加や主要７カ国（Ｇ７）による緊急備蓄からのディーゼル燃料放出計画と、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の攻撃に伴う供給懸念とを見極める展開となった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．２６ドル（０．３％）高の１バレル＝１００．５８ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．０１ドル高の８９．４４ドル。

大手石油商社ビトルの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は６日、価格上昇圧力を和らげるために必要な量とされる日量約１２００万バレルの原油と同２００万バレルの石油製品が、過去７─１０日間に中東から出荷されたと明らかにした。

サウジアラビアのアブドルアジズエネルギー相も６日、紅海沿岸の石油輸出拠点ヤンブーに通じる東西パイプラインの送油量が、同日朝の時点で５８０万バレルに達したと明らかにした。

こうした中、サウジアラビア航空当局は、フーシ派との対立が激化する中、ジャザンとナジュランにあるサウジの２空港が５日に攻撃の標的となり、３人が負傷し、限定的な被害が出たと明らかにした。中東でのさらなる供給途絶の可能性が意識され、原油価格の下落幅は限定的なものにとどまった。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: BYD will struggle to do a better Toyota impression
item.description: Founder Wang Chuanfu wants to overtake the world’s largest automaker. His $102 bln electric car group already resembles the Japanese giant’s younger self. But becoming a true doppelganger means charming hostile markets, quintupling overseas factories, and doubling down on trucks.
item.dc:creator: Katrina Hamlin
item.content:encoded: BYD (002594.SZ) , short for “build your dreams”, may not fulfill those of its founder. Wang Chuanfu told shareholders at an investor meeting in June the Shenzhen company aims to [USN:L1N42I02P TEXT:"become"] the world’s largest carmaker by 2030 – a plan that entails overtaking Toyota (7203.T) , which sold roughly 11 million cars last year. BYD is retracing the path the Japanese giant took in its early decades, but the next steps are harder to follow. Wang has long watched Toyota. Early BYD models were eerily similar to the Japanese marque’s bestsellers: the 2008 F3 sedan was hailed as a “ Corolla ripoff ”. In some ways, the company itself has become a dead ringer for the young Toyota. It has risen by pushing an affordable alternative to fuel-intensive gas guzzlers, at a time when geopolitics and climate change make cutting dependency on oil a priority for both policymakers and consumers. Decades ago, Toyota also won over drivers with efficient engines and lighter models. In the wake of the 1970s oil crisis, its Corolla outshone heavier, thirstier cars made by American rivals such as Ford Motor (F.N) . BYD leads in its home market, with 12% share as of August according to Shanghai consultancy Automobility, just as Toyota dominates in Japan. It’s driving exports to the limit too – they make up nearly half its sales, riling China’s trade partners. That also echoes Toyota: By 1980, the majority of its cars ended up overseas, prompting the US and the then European Community to negotiate import quotas with Tokyo. This combination of commercial aggression and technical prowess saw BYD car deliveries reach 4.6 million in 2025, on a par with Toyota's annual volumes in 1997. However, their paths may yet diverge. Toyota matured in a very different environment. While the global vehicle market expanded by about 20 million units over the 1980s and 1990s to reach nearly 60 million at the turn of the century – ample space for the Japanese group to grow into - the next decade could see slower or even stagnant growth. If you sell 10 million cars, someone else loses 10 million, as CLSA analyst Xiao Feng puts it. The world’s auto producing nations are upping their guard against newcomers. Drivers can buy Toyotas in around 170 different markets. BYD has entered about 120 countries and territories. But it has no or limited access to three of the world’s top ten auto markets, namely the US - Toyota's largest source of sales - plus India and Japan. Together, they accounted for some 22 million passenger vehicles last year, roughly a quarter of the industry total. Changing the status quo is beyond Wang’s control. Friendlier nations let millions of Chinese cars in. But many are now raising the price of entry. The EU, the world’s second-largest market for electric cars, has imposed an additional 17% duty on BYD’s imports from the People’s Republic. Brussels is under pressure to consider [USN:L6N45A06Z TEXT:"more mechanisms"] to control import volumes, particularly for hybrid powertrains. Brazil introduced 35% tariffs in July. Mexico, Russia and Thailand all have levies in place, and the UK [USN:FWN45Q005 TEXT:"may"] soon introduce duties too. Meanwhile, Beijing itself is signaling [USN:L6N44U09P TEXT:"unease"] as passenger vehicle exports [USN:L6N43H04Q TEXT:"break records"] and look set to top 10 million units this year, angering trade partners. Three ministries have thrown their weight behind new guidelines for exporting automakers, urging them to respect local regulations and avoid disruptive competition. Authorities could take more concrete steps, such as removing a generous 13% export tax rebate. On top of that, domestic sales are slowing. China’s dealer association expects a double-digit percentage drop this year, and Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) warned investors the market could contract by 20%. All of that complicates BYD’s efforts to shift the roughly 6 million cars it is capable of churning out in China each year, as estimated by Automobility founder Bill Russo. Making cars abroad – as Toyota started doing in 1959 – circumvents tariffs and other roadblocks. BYD has announced overseas factories across Hungary, Thailand, Brazil, Uzbekistan and Indonesia, whose combined capacity would amount to nearly 1 million units a year, according to Citi research. It’s also [USN:L8N4581FT TEXT:"looking into"] deals to take advantage of existing production sites, Reuters reported, which should be faster than building. It is possible to ramp up international supply chains quickly – Toyota itself doubled overseas production to 4 million in just five years between 2002 and 2007. But Wang would need to at least quintuple capacity outside China to about 5 million to reach his goal of surpassing Toyota’s current volumes, assuming China sales stay flat. There are other ways to top up volumes here and there. One more Toyota trick BYD is trying is expanding its product range. Just like 1980s Toyota, which launched the Lexus marque in 1989, it has successfully branched into premium products: the high-end Denza and Fangchengbao brands accounted for more than 10% of sales as of the first quarter, according to analysts at Sunwah Kingsway. Cutting-edge technology like its fast-charging batteries, which can charge to 97% capacity in under 9 minutes, and sophisticated digital cockpits could help it wrestle new buyers from incumbents – including Toyota. Trucks and vans present another promising area. For the first half of the Toyota group’s existence, up until the 1960s, commercial vehicles accounted for more than half of export volumes. Wang is only just getting started on that front. At BYD, commercial vehicles – mostly buses – contributed less than 2% of total sales so far this year. He has an opportunity to do much more: e-truck deliveries reached 30% of sales in China in 2025, compared with almost none in 2021, and exports have spiked since the Iran war broke out. The company’s commercial vehicle sales are growing fast, rising 28% in the first three quarters, when BYD's car sales fell 4%. Last month it also announced a plan to [USN:L8N4560Y9 TEXT:"make"] heavy-duty trucks in Europe. It’s much less experienced than beefier rivals like Sany Heavy, which is expanding rapidly. But it might take share from legacy groups that remain more focused on gasoline. BYD is doing a remarkably good impression of a young Toyota, and Wang is still finding new ways to mimic the world’s largest carmaker. But catching up with the $220 billion juggernaut looks like a tall order, especially by 2030. That doesn’t mean Chair Akio Toyoda can rest easy: the Japanese group will be a prime target as its Chinese twin hunts for more market share. Follow Katrina Hamlin on Bluesky and LinkedIn

item.title: Anthropic disponibiliza seus modelos de IA mais poderosos para mais equipes de segurança

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Anthropic está ampliando um programa que permite que profissionais de segurança digital credenciados testem seus modelos de inteligência artificial mais poderosos com menos medidas de proteção, depois que sua iniciativa “Projeto Glasswing” ajudou a identificar mais de 100 mil vulnerabilidades de software neste ano. Os parceiros no Glasswing, uma iniciativa que visa proteger os softwares mais críticos do mundo, identificaram pelo menos 129 mil vulnerabilidades confirmadas entre abril e julho. A própria varredura de código aberto da Anthropic encontrou mais 5.500 entre abril e outubro. Mais de 33.000 foram classificadas até o momento como críticas ou de alta gravidade. A Anthropic afirmou que os números provavelmente estão subestimados e espera que o impacto real seja pelo menos cinco vezes maior, já que os dados provêm de uma pesquisa com um número limitado de parceiros. O Programa de Verificação Cibernética (CVP), reformulado e anunciado nesta terça-feira, combina dois programas que a Anthropic vem executando nos últimos seis meses. O primeiro, o Glasswing, proporcionou às organizações que protegem softwares críticos acesso ao Claude Mythos, a família de modelos da Anthropic com maior capacidade. O segundo, o CVP original, concedeu a equipes de segurança aprovadas acesso com restrições reduzidas aos modelos Claude Opus e Sonnet. O lançamento do Claude Mythos Preview pela empresa, em abril, gerou receios de que a IA atacar invadir softwares antes que eles fossem protegidos. O novo programa possui três níveis, cada um com seus próprios requisitos de verificação e controles de segurança. Todos os três incluem acesso ao Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Mythos 5.1 e modelos futuros. O nível “Defesa” abrange atividades como resposta a incidentes e análise de malware. Podem se inscrever equipes de segurança, operadores de infraestrutura crítica, mantenedores de código aberto e pesquisadores com histórico de vulnerabilidades relatadas. O nível “Red Team” acrescenta testes de penetração autorizados e simulações de ataques (red-teaming), mas apenas organizações podem se inscrever. O nível “Specialized” tem o menor número de restrições e é reservado a um pequeno grupo de organizações autorizadas a testar sistemas críticos para a segurança, como redes de energia, sistemas de voo e infraestrutura de transferências interbancárias. A Anthropic avalia cada membro em conjunto com o governo dos EUA, e os membros atuais do Glasswing passarão para esse nível. (Por Anzar Mehraj)

item.title: BofA ve riesgo de burbuja en tecnológicas y propone opciones para aprovechar el Nasdaq 100
item.description: El Nasdaq 100 alcanza máximos históricos impulsado por un reducido grupo de acciones de IA, mientras BofA advierte que la baja amplitud del mercado es una señal clásica de formación de burbujas.
item.dc:creator: Bernard Goyder
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los inversores que se muestran recelosos ante la idea de invertir en las megacapitalizaciones tecnológicas que están impulsando al índice Nasdaq 100 a máximos históricos aún pueden aprovechar el repunte mediante derivados sobre acciones y evitar las consecuencias de una posible burbuja, según los estrategas de Bank of America Corp. ( BAC ). Si bien el índice, con un fuerte peso tecnológico, sigue subiendo con fuerza, sin dejarse afectar por el alza de los rendimientos de los bonos, el ascenso del índice de referencia viene impulsado por tan solo un puñado de valores relacionados con la inteligencia artificial, lo que suscita la preocupación de que las acciones tecnológicas estén mostrando características propias de una burbuja. Ver más: En qué invertir en Wall Street: las recomendaciones de UBS en tecnología y telecomunicaciones “La escasa amplitud del mercado es una característica clásica de la formación de burbujas y, por lo general, no se detiene hasta que estas estallan”, escriben en una nota publicada el martes varios estrategas, entre ellos Arjun Goyal, Riddhi Prasad y Benjamin Bowler. Para los inversores preocupados por quedarse al margen y obtener un rendimiento inferior al de sus homólogos que han invertido íntegramente en el Nasdaq 100, las opciones son una herramienta más eficaz que poseer las acciones subyacentes, afirmaron. Recomiendan opciones de compra sobre el ETF Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ), que replica el Nasdaq 100. “Seguimos valorando positivamente los spreads de opciones de compra sobre el QQQ como una forma atractiva de aprovechar el potencial alcista con un riesgo limitado”, escriben. Ver más: Acciones de hardware tecnológico de China caen 30% y cierran su peor trimestre por dudas sobre la IA Las posiciones alcistas en opciones, que se benefician del aumento del precio del activo subyacente, pueden financiarse con la prima obtenida mediante la venta de un “seguro” frente a una caída del Nasdaq 100, señalaron. Bank of America clasifica 32 clases de activos y sectores según su grado de sobrevaloración. “Las acciones tecnológicas estadounidenses... se sitúan actualmente con la lectura más alta del (Indicador de Riesgo de Burbuja)”, según BofA. Otras clases de activos que figuran en los primeros puestos de la lista son el petróleo, el sector sanitario y las acciones surcoreanas, un mercado dominado por dos empresas tecnológicas: SK Hynix Inc. ( SKHY ) y Samsung Electronics Co Ltd. Los operadores más experimentados podrían contratar opciones exóticas con los intermediarios que generen beneficios si el Nasdaq 100 sube a medida que las tasas de interés sigan aumentando, añadió el estratega de BofA. Lea más en Bloomberg.com
