item.title: 英国経済、高インフレが定着＝中銀のマン委員
item.description: [ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員は６日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英国経済、高インフレが定着＝中銀のマン委員 10/6 18:49 配信

写真はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員。2023年1月、英マンチェスターで撮影。REUTERS/Phil Noble

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員は６日、２％の目標を上回るインフレが英国経済に定着してしまったようだと述べた。

経済助言会社ＴＳロンバードが主催した会議で「私がこの職に就いて以来、インフレ率は一貫して目標を大幅に上回ってきた。インフレは定着してしまった」と語った。

また、賃金交渉が活発化する年末年始ごろにインフレ率が４％に達する見通しであることに特に懸念を示した。

マン氏は、英国の経済需要は力強いとは思えないものの、ポジティブとの見解を示した。

さらに、最近の労働生産性データの上方改定が労働時間の下方改定によるものだったことに触れ、これが将来的にインフレを伴わない成長を実現する経済の能力を制限する可能性があるとの見解を示した。

マン氏は７月以来、政策金利を０．２５ポイント引き上げて４％とする案に賛成票を投じる少数派の一員となっている。

item.description: [ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、最近...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ安全網、議論の時期ではない＝フィンランド中銀総裁 10/6 18:36 配信

写真は欧州中央銀行（ECB）本部ビルの外に掲げられたロゴ。2018年4月、フランクフルトで撮影。REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach

[ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、最近の債券利回り上昇にもかかわらず、ユーロ圏の金融政策伝達メカニズムは適切に機能しているとし、ＥＣＢのセーフティーネット（安全網）について議論する時期ではないと述べた。

ＥＣＢがフランス債券市場への支援を検討すべきかとの問いに、フランス銀行（中銀）のムーラン総裁の見解に「全面的に同意する」と回答。そのような支援の議論は時宜を得ておらず、各国は自国の財政の持続可能性を確保しなければならないとの考えを示した。

item.title: アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（16日）
item.description: 香港株式市場は海外市場に追随して堅調。製薬株やハイテク株が上昇した。 ハンセン指数は１％高。ハンセン中国株指数は１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（16日） 10/6 18:34 配信

香港株式市場は海外市場に追随して堅調。製薬株やハイテク株が上昇した。    ハンセン指数は１％高。ハンセン中国株指数は１％近く上昇した。    ハンセン・バイオテック指数は３．２%上昇し、ハンセン・テック指数は０．９%上昇した。    HSBC Qianhaiの中国ヘルスケア調査責任者リンダ・シュー氏はリポートで「２０２６年には主要な製薬企業のほとんどが堅調な成長を遂げると予想している」と記した。    半面、主要な不動産開発会社の株価は下落し、新鴻基地産（サンフンカイ・プロパティーズ）は０．６％安、長江実業集団（ＣＫアセット・ホールディングス）は０．３％安となった。    ＵＯＢケイヒアンは「（住宅）価格は２０２６年を通じてもみ合いが続くと予想している」と指摘した。    新世界発展（ニューワールド・デベロップメント）３．５％安。２７年および２８年に満期を迎える一部社債について、３２年に満期を迎える新たな担保付社債とスワップする債務交換オファーを発表した。    中国本土の金融市場は国慶節（建国記念日）の連休で７日まで休場。取引は８日に再開する。

休場明けのソウル株式市場は下落。今週発表されるサムスン電子の決算を控え、半導体株が売られた。

未来アセット証券のアナリスト、ソ・サンヨン氏は「メモリー半導体価格の継続的な上昇を背景にサムスン電子の決算は良好な内容になるとみられるが、債券利回りの高止まりが相場全般の重しとなっている」と指摘した。

半導体のサムスン電子は１．４５％安、同業のＳＫハイニックスは３．６９％下落した。

電池メーカーのＬＧエネルギーソリューションが５．１２％上昇。現代自動車は０．４３％高、傘下の起亜は０．２７％安だった。

売買された９１８銘柄のうち、値上がりは４２５、値下がりは４６１。

外国人投資家は差し引き１兆８０００億ウォン（１３億４０００万ドル）の売り越し。

シドニー株式市場は３営業日続伸して取引を終えた。銅価格の上昇を背景に主力鉱山株が買われたほか、原油安でインフレ懸念が和らいだ。

金融株指数は０．７％上昇し、３営業日続伸。４大銀行は全て上昇し、上昇率は０．６─０．８％だった。不動産株指数は１．１％上昇し、４営業日ぶりに反発した。センター・グループは２．７％、ＧＰＴグループは２．３％それぞれ上昇した。

鉱業株指数は銅価格の上昇を受けて０．９％上昇した。業界大手のＢＨＰグループは１．６％高となり、約１カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。ハイテク株指数は３％近く下落し、１カ月余りで最大の下落率を記録した。ワイズテック・グローバルは２．５％下落し、下げを主導した。

item.title: 英建設ＰＭＩ、9月46.1に改善 新規受注は引き続き低迷
item.description:
David Milliken
[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが６日発表した英国の９月の建設業購買担...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英建設ＰＭＩ、9月46.1に改善　新規受注は引き続き低迷 10/6 18:31 配信

写真は6月9日、ロンドンの建設現場で撮影。REUTERS/Chris J. Ratcliffe

David Milliken

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが６日発表した英国の９月の建設業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は４６．１だった。８月の４４．３から改善したものの、好不況の分かれ目である５０を引き続き下回った。ただ落ち込みは１月以降で最も穏やかだった。

英建設業ＰＭＩは２０２５年１月から５０を下回っている。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスの経済ディレクター、ティム・ムーア氏は「９月の新規受注は相対的に低迷した。建設企業は営業から受注までの期間が長期化しており、顧客が大型プロジェクトの意思決定を先送りにしていると指摘した」と述べた。

・新規受注指数は４５．９で、前月の４７．７から低下し３カ月ぶりの低水準。

・投入価格の上昇率は２月のイラン戦争勃発以来、最も緩やかなペースとなった。ただしムーア氏は、エネルギーコストの上昇を踏まえると、この傾向が続く可能性は低いと述べた。

・今後の活動見通しは５月以来で最も弱かった。

・部門別では住宅建設が引き続き最も低調で、土木工事がこれに続いた。一方、商業施設は小幅な低下にとどまった。

・サービス、製造業、建設業のＰＭＩデータを含む全セクターＰＭＩは５１．５で前月の５１．８から低下し、３カ月ぶりの低水準。

item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝香港堅調、製薬・ハイテク株が上昇 10/6 18:13 配信

[香港 ６日 ロイター] - 香港株式市場は海外市場に追随して堅調。製薬株やハイテク株が上昇した。

ハンセン指数は１％高。ハンセン中国株指数は１％近く上昇した。

ハンセン・バイオテック指数は３．２%上昇し、ハンセン・テック指数は０．９%上昇した。

HSBC Qianhaiの中国ヘルスケア調査責任者リンダ・シュー氏はリポートで「２０２６年には主要な製薬企業のほとんどが堅調な成長を遂げると予想している」と記した。

半面、主要な不動産開発会社の株価は下落し、新鴻基地産（サンフンカイ・プロパティーズ）は０．６％安、長江実業集団（ＣＫアセット・ホールディングス）は０．３％安となった。

ＵＯＢケイヒアンは「（住宅）価格は２０２６年を通じてもみ合いが続くと予想している」と指摘した。

新世界発展（ニューワールド・デベロップメント）３．５％安。２７年および２８年に満期を迎える一部社債について、３２年に満期を迎える新たな担保付社債とスワップする債務交換オファーを発表した。

中国本土の金融市場は国慶節（建国記念日）の連休で７日まで休場。取引は８日に再開する。

item.title: Italy regulator probes AI music startup Suno over terms of service
item.description: Italy's antitrust authority said on Tuesday it had opened an investigation into AI music startup Suno, saying some clauses in its terms of service may be unfair to consumers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Italy's antitrust authority said on Tuesday it had opened an investigation into AI music startup Suno, saying some clauses in its terms of service may be unfair to consumers. Suno was not immediately available for comment Suno's terms could create a significant imbalance in the rights and obligations of users, the watchdog said They give Suno "broad discretion" to unilaterally modify its contract, service and subscription prices without having to provide any justification, it added in a statement The regulator said the licence granted by users was excessively broad and included a waiver of moral rights that may conflict with Italian copyright law Suno's terms require users to resolve disputes through mandatory arbitration in the United States, waive class-action rights and accept Massachusetts as the exclusive jurisdiction for legal claims, the authority said It added it would launch a consultation in the coming weeks in which interested business groups, chambers of commerce and consumer associations could participate

item.description:
Miho Uranaka Yantoultra Ngui
[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 米投資会社ベインキャピタルとシ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ベインとＧＩＣ、人事システムＷＨＩの上場・売却を検討　企業価値5000億円超目指す＝関係者 10/6 18:08 配信

写真は米投資会社ベインキャピタルのロゴイメージ。2月4日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Miho Uranaka　Yantoultra Ngui

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 米投資会社ベインキャピタルとシンガポール政府系ファンドのＧＩＣが、人事管理システムを手がけるＷＨＩホールディングス（東京都港区）について、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）または第三者への売却を検討しており、５０００億円超の企業価値を目指していることが分かった。事情に詳しい関係者２人が明らかにした。

関係者によると、両社は、このプロセスの一環として、アドバイザーや潜在的な買い手、投資家への打診を始めている。選択肢の一つとして日本市場への上場が検討されているほか、事業会社や他のファンドなどへの売却も検討しているという。

協議は初期段階にあり、最終的な決定は下されていない。ベインとＧＩＣは最終的に保有を継続する可能性もあるという。

ベインとＧＩＣはコメントを控えた。ＷＨＩのコメントは現時点で得られていない。

ベインは２０１９年、ワークスアプリケーションズ（同千代田区）から人事ソフト事業を取得し、ＷＨＩを発足させた。取得額は公表されていない。２０２３年３月にはＧＩＣがＷＨＩに共同出資し、両社は共同支配株主となった。

ＷＨＩ傘下の中核事業会社ワークスヒューマンインテリジェンスは、人事管理、給与計算、勤怠管理、タレントマネジメントなどの機能を備えた大企業向け人事システム「ＣＯＭＰＡＮＹ」の開発・販売・サポートを手掛ける。ＷＨＩホールディングスのホームページによると、国内大手法人約１２００グループで利用されている。

item.title: ルペン氏、歳出削減目標1400億ユーロ 仏大統領選にらみ財政構想
item.description: [パリ ６日 ロイター] - フランスの極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」のマリーヌ・ルペン氏は６日、来年の大統領選挙を見据え...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ルペン氏、歳出削減目標1400億ユーロ　仏大統領選にらみ財政構想 10/6 18:00 配信

写真は極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」 のマリーヌ・ルペン氏。10月6日、パリで撮影。REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

[パリ ６日 ロイター] - フランスの極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」のマリーヌ・ルペン氏は６日、来年の大統領選挙を見据えて、財政運営方針を示した。同国の債務が雪だるま式に膨らむ危機に瀕していると指摘し、歳出削減規模を従来方針から拡大した。

＜就任後１８カ月以内に基礎的財政収支均衡＞

ルペン氏は、大統領に就任した場合、就任後１８カ月以内に基礎的財政収支を均衡させると述べた。

財政赤字の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比率を２０３０年までに３％未満にし、任期最終年の３２年までに２．５％未満に引き下げるとした。

公的債務は２７年のＧＤＰ比約１２１％から３２年までに１１２％に下げる。

歳出は、３２年までに、少なくとも３００億ユーロの減税分を差し引いて１４００億ユーロ（１５７０億ドル）削減する。任期終了までに公的支出をＧＤＰ比５０％未満に下げるとした。

財政の混乱は選挙戦の最大の争点になっている。

ルペン氏は、現在ＧＤＰ比１１９％の公的債務が６０％に下がるまで、財政赤字を毎年少なくとも０．５ポイント減らすことを義務付ける「黄金律」を国民投票にかけ、財政規律を憲法に明記したいと述べた。

また欧州連合（ＥＵ）の予算協議でフランスの純拠出額を５０億ユーロ（５６億１０００万ドル）に減らすよう求める考えを示した。

さらに、数週間以内にフランスの年金制度に関する提案を行うと表明した。節税スキームを利用して納税額を圧縮している多国籍企業への対策として、売上高に占めるフランス国内での売上高の割合に基づいて課税する方針を示した。

＜金利上昇巡りＥＣＢと協議＞

同氏は、フランスが財政を再び管理できるようになった段階で、借り入れコストを引き下げるための介入について欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）と協議すべきだと述べた。

ＥＣＢには、市場の圧力に直面したユーロ加盟国の国債を、健全な経済政策の維持を条件に買い入れる伝達保護措置（ＴＰＩ）という制度がある。レスキュール経済・財務相は６日、同国の国債市場の混乱について、資金調達環境の安定に向けてＴＰＩの活用を検討する段階には至っていないとの認識を示した。

item.title: 英、米メタを調査 インスタの「インスタンツ」機能巡り
item.description: ［６日 ロイター］ - 英情報通信庁は６日、米メタ・プラットフォームズの写真共有アプリ「インスタグラム」の新機能「イン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英、米メタを調査　インスタの「インスタンツ」機能巡り 10/6 17:54 配信

写真はインスタグラムのロゴイメージ。8月13日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

［６日　ロイター］ - 英情報通信庁は６日、米メタ・プラットフォームズの写真共有アプリ「インスタグラム」の新機能「インスタンツ（Instants）」を巡り調査を開始したと発表した。導入前にリスクを適切に評価しておらず、同国のオンライン安全関連法に違反した疑いがあるとした。

インスタンツは、利用者が共有したコンテンツが閲覧後に消去される機能で５月に導入された。

情報通信庁は、メタが新機能を導入する前に違法コンテンツのリスクや児童への潜在的リスクについて「適切かつ十分な」評価を実施したかどうかを確認する方針。

オフコムの執行責任者ジョージ・ラスティ氏は「われわれのオンライン安全法は明確だ。プラットフォームの重大な変更は立ち上げ前にリスク評価を受けなければならない」と述べた。

安全性は設計段階から組み込む必要があり、後付けするものではないと指摘。「本日の調査開始は、提供事業者がコンプライアンス違反の懸念がある場合、われわれが行動することを示している」とした。

メタは、オンライン安全法に基づく規制上の義務を真剣に受け止めているとし、調査に協力すると述べた。

同社の広報担当者は「リスク分析を実施した上で、導入前に何度もＯｆｃｏｍに同機能について説明した」と述べた。

「インスタンツには保護機能が組み込まれている。スクリーンショットや再共有、転送はできず、公開フィードもない。『ティーンアカウント』の保護機能も自動で有効になる」とした。

item.description: [ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、ユーロ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ユーロ圏金利上昇、エネ価格の波及を抑制＝フィンランド中銀総裁 10/6 17:42 配信

写真は欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁。2019年5月、英ロンドンで撮影。REUTERS/Hannah McKay

[ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、ユーロ圏全体で急速に進んでいるエネルギー価格の上昇はまだ他の財やサービスには波及しておらず、最近の債券利回りの上昇は成長を圧迫することで物価上昇圧力を和らげる可能性が高いと述べた。

多くの政策当局者がインフレリスクは予想よりも高めに傾いていると指摘する中、レーン氏は、経済には相反する力が働いているため、他にも考慮すべき点があると指摘。「長期金利の上昇は成長の鈍化につながるだけでなく、エネルギー価格が他の物価や賃金に波及する度合いを弱めている」と語った。

また、人工知能（ＡＩ）への力強い投資などにより、経済が並外れた強靭性を示しているとも指摘した。

一部の政策当局者はこうした強靭性について、これまで考えられていたよりも強い物価上昇圧力を示唆していると指摘している。

item.content:encoded:
訂正-インタビュー：個人向け国債「桁違い」に拡大する必要＝自民・中西氏 10/6 17:27 配信

写真は円紙幣のイメージ。2022年11月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

(本文３段落目の「２５年度」を「２００５年度」に訂正します)

Makiko Yamazaki　Takaya Yamaguchi

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - 自民党の中西健治議員は６日、国債発行全体に占める個人向け販売を「桁違い」に拡大する必要があると述べた。税優遇を含む商品設計の見直しを通じ、国債消化の柱のひとつに据える考えを強調した。ロイターとのインタビューで語った。

財務省が６日発表した１０月発行分の個人向け国債（１０年変動、５年固定、３年固定）は１兆０２５１億円だった。

年度ベースでは累計６兆１６４１億円となり、当初計画（５兆９０００億円）をすでに上回った。過去最大だった２００５年度（訂正、７兆２７１２億円）を上回るペースにある。

ただ、中西氏は「もっと買ってもらえる余地はある」と強調。「そのための後押しは必要」との考えを述べた。

日銀が国債買い入れを減らす中、２０００兆円を超える家計の金融資産をどう取り込むかは、今後の財政運営を占う試金石となる。金利上昇に伴う個人向け国債の売れ行きは好調だが、保有比率は依然として低い。

中西氏はインタビューで、税優遇を含む商品設計の見直しにも言及。利回り曲線が傾斜化し、超長期債利回りが「魅力的な水準になってきている。（１０年を超える）長いものも、あったらいい」としている。

item.content:encoded:
インフレ二次的効果、現時点でそれほど強くない＝ＥＣＢ専務理事 10/6 17:02 配信

欧州中央銀行（ECB）チーフエコノミストのレーン専務理事。6月16日、ロンドンで撮影。REUTERS/Chris J. Ratcliffe

[フランクフルト ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）チーフエコノミストのレーン専務理事はイタリアの通信社ＡＮＳＡに対し、ユーロ圏における高いエネルギーコストはまだ二次的なインフレ効果をもたらしておらず、そうした効果の強さも不透明だと述べた。

６日に配信されたインタビューで「現時点では、それほど強い二次的効果は見られていない。引き続き注視している」と説明。「私自身はさまざまなシナリオを提唱している立場ではあるが、われわれが『悪化シナリオ』にあるとか、『基本シナリオ』にあると断言するのはあまりに短絡的だ」と語った。

「エネルギー価格は高いが、経済の他の分野への波及の強さは依然として不透明だ」と付け加えた。

item.title: UK watchdog opens first Online Safety Act probe into Meta
item.description: Britain's communications regulator opened its first formal investigation into Meta under the Online Safety Act on Tuesday, questioning whether it properly assessed risks posed by its Instagram Instants feature before launching it in May.
item.dc:creator: Paul Sandle
item.content:encoded: Britain's communications regulator opened its first formal investigation into Meta under the Online Safety Act on Tuesday, questioning whether it properly assessed risks posed by its Instagram Instants feature before launching it in May. Instants allows content shared by users on Instagram to disappear after being viewed. Ofcom said its investigation would establish whether Meta carried out a "suitable and sufficient" assessment of the risks of illegal content on the feature and any risks posed to children before its launch. George Lusty, director of enforcement at Ofcom, said: "Our online safety laws are clear — significant changes to platforms must be risk assessed before they're launched." Safety by design had to be built in and not bolted on, he said. "Today's investigation shows we'll take action where we have concerns that providers are failing to comply," he said. Meta said it took its regulatory obligations under the Online Safety Act seriously. "We conducted a risk analysis and briefed Ofcom about this feature on a number of occasions before launching it," a spokesperson said. "Instants has in-built protections, including blocking screenshots, reshares and forwarding, no public feed, and Teen Account protections on automatically." "We will of course co-operate with Ofcom during this investigation," the spokesperson said. Ofcom's first investigation under the Online Safety Act was into an online suicide discussion forum last year, followed by probes into pornography sites, file-sharing services used to distribute child sexual abuse material, and platforms such as 4chan. Britain's online safety regime sets obligations for social media platforms, search engines and adult content providers to tackle illegal content and to protect children's safety. Ofcom requires companies to conduct risk assessments and implement safety measures, such as age verification. If a company fails to comply, Ofcom can impose fines of up to £18 million or 10% of qualifying worldwide revenue, whichever is greater. Meta has launched legal challenges against Ofcom over its implementation of the act, including the scale and scope of information it has to provide to the regulator and the level of fees Ofcom charges. In January, Ofcom launched an investigation into Meta over the provision of information about its WhatsApp Business product under a separate Communications Act.

item.title: Former German Intelligence Chief August Hanning arrested on alleged treason and espionage charges
item.description: In an official statement, the Federal Prosecutor’s Office announced that the two German nationals were taken into custody on Tuesday, in Bad Tölz-Wolfratshausen County, Bavaria, and Steinfurt County, ...
item.content:encoded:
Former German Intelligence Chief August Hanning arrested on alleged treason and espionage charges In an official statement, the Federal Prosecutor’s Office announced that the two German nationals were taken into custody on Tuesday, in Bad Tölz-Wolfratshausen County, Bavaria, and Steinfurt County, North Rhine-Westphalia, pursuant to warrants issued by the Investigating Judge at the Federal Court of Justice. Law enforcement officers simultaneously searched properties in both locations as well as in Berlin. ANI | Updated: 06-10-2026 20:29 IST | Created: 06-10-2026 20:29 IST

Former General Federal Intelligence Service (BND) President August Hanning (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Germany's Federal Criminal Police Office agents have arrested former Federal Intelligence Service (BND) President August Hanning and his former chief of staff, Manfred D, on serious charges including treasonous espionage, spying on state secrets, attempted treason, and espionage, Euro News reported. In an official statement, the Federal Prosecutor’s Office announced that the two German nationals were taken into custody on Tuesday, in Bad Tölz-Wolfratshausen County, Bavaria, and Steinfurt County, North Rhine-Westphalia, pursuant to warrants issued by the Investigating Judge at the Federal Court of Justice. Law enforcement officers simultaneously searched properties in both locations as well as in Berlin. Hanning, who served as President of the BND from December 1998 to November 2005 and later as State Secretary at the Federal Ministry of the Interior between December 2005 and November 2009, is "strongly suspected of treasonous espionage, spying out state secrets, attempted treason, and espionage." Manfred D, who served as Hanning's chief of staff at the BND and parliamentary assistant at the Interior Ministry before resuming duties as chief of staff for several subsequent BND presidents from March 2012 to March 2026, is charged with "aiding and abetting attempted treason and treasonous espionage." According to federal prosecutors, the two suspects agreed in the spring of 2010 that Manfred D would systematically leak confidential intelligence files to Hanning in exchange for payment. Over the years, Manfred D allegedly provided Hanning with approximately 2,000 documents, many containing restricted intelligence intended strictly for internal agency use and executive briefings involving senior officials from federal ministries and German security agencies at the Federal Chancellery. Investigators revealed that Hanning utilised the classified material to enhance his private consultancy services. Prosecutors stated that on one occasion, Hanning "used classified intelligence provided by Manfred D. to draft an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service," though it remains undetermined if the report reached its destination. Furthermore, Hanning was "in close contact with a representative of another foreign intelligence service, to whom he passed on political information, partially based on material provided by Manfred D., for several years." The wide-ranging probe originated after a search of Hanning's property by Hamburg prosecutors in September 2025 during an investigation involving German businesswoman Christina Block and alleged leaks from the Chancellery. Euronews, citing reports by the German newspaper Süddeutsche Zeitung, along with public broadcasters WDR and NDR, previously pointed to evidence uncovered during those proceedings regarding the unauthorised handling of sensitive state documents. The Federal Prosecutor's Office officially took over the investigation in early May 2026, conducting the probe alongside the BND and the Federal Criminal Police Office. Both suspects were brought before the Investigating Judge at the Federal Court of Justice to review the charges and determine pre-trial detention. (ANI)

item.title: School protests sweeping France cause 'heaviest toll in decades'
item.description: Demonstrations swept across France on Tuesday as teachers and parents took to the streets with high school pupils on the biggest day of what Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu described as the most violent student demonstrations in decades.
item.dc:creator: Tilman Blasshofer, Cecile Mantovani, Lucien Libert
item.content:encoded: Demonstrations swept across France on Tuesday as teachers and parents took to the streets with high school pupils on the biggest day of what Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu described as the most violent student demonstrations in decades. Police fired tear gas and water cannons to disperse violent groups on the fringes of marches in Paris, Strasbourg, Rennes and Toulouse, among other cities. The marches drew more than 250,000 people in dozens of cities, the interior ministry said, though organisers said 450,000 had participated. The protests, in which a teenager lost a hand on Monday, were the latest manifestation of public anger in a country where support for populist parties on the far right and far left has surged ahead of a presidential election in the spring. The government is under pressure to tame public debt amid weak growth, and has struggled with basic tasks such as passing a budget since President Emmanuel Macron's allies lost their majority in a 2024 parliamentary vote. Lecornu told lawmakers at least 215 teenagers and 85 school staff had so far been injured in clashes, "the heaviest toll in decades paid by the school system". His office said more than 700 police officers were also hurt. Macron has convened Lecornu and other senior ministers at an emergency meeting on Tuesday, broadcaster BFM reported. US President Donald Trump said the protests were evidence of "out of control" migration in France. "This isn't about schools, this is about Islam wanting to take over a once great Country," he posted on Truth Social. The students' demands do not concern religion or immigration, but focus instead on understaffing and lack of funding. Marine Le Pen's far-right National Rally party has not linked the protests to France's migration policy. Lecornu's office did not respond to a request for comment. In Marseille and Nantes, protesters held up handmade signs bearing phrases such as "The state has killed national education". In Toulouse, parents linked arms at the front of a march through the city. Paris police said clashes in the capital resulted from some 300 people, most hooded or masked, facing off against security forces, and that the protest generally unfolded without major incident elsewhere. Several storefronts were damaged. The Interior Ministry said 488 people had been arrested and 48 security personnel were injured on Tuesday. MAINTENANCE COMPLAINTS The student protests began in September in the deprived suburbs of Paris before spreading nationwide. Students complain about schools facing basic maintenance problems, from water leaks to rat infestations. "There is such a gap between the elites and us," said Hugo Vetzel, a recent high-school graduate in Strasbourg. The High School Students Union said more than half of France's high schools were blockaded or had closed for the day. Some local education authorities have tried to move classes online. Rights groups, students and parent groups have accused authorities of using disproportionate force against minors. The government says the protest movement has been hijacked by outsiders and in some places deteriorated into urban violence. More than 1,800 people are being prosecuted for unspecified crimes, including 1,483 minors, the justice ministry said on Monday. "They want to divide the young people into good and bad protesters," said Omar Slaouti, a high-school teacher in Argenteuil, a northwestern suburb of Paris. "If there were no trash cans on fire, the government would not have stepped back and become aware of the issues at stake." PRIME MINISTER PROMISES A RESPONSE Lecornu has ordered his ministers to tackle the students' leading demands. Those include ensuring absent teachers are replaced, reviewing the length of the 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. school day and the need for longer lunch breaks. The government will also look at repairs needed to ageing school buildings, said Lecornu, who demanded ministers send in their first proposals by the end of October. Parent Emilie Lhomme said at a protest outside the Helene Boucher school in Paris that the government's words were not enough: "That's all fine and dandy, but that's not what's going to change the daily lives of our children," she said. Finding spare cash to implement educational reforms will be difficult. The government is under pressure to try to narrow a ballooning budget deficit as investor concerns about France's growing debt, weak growth and reluctance to rein in spending push the cost of borrowing higher. The yield on [USN:L8N45O0YO TEXT:"France's 10-year bonds"] briefly hit a 24-year high of over 5% last week. The surge in French borrowing costs has started to spill into the broader euro area, with the [USN:L6N45S0D2 TEXT:"sliding euro currency"] the latest alarm bell for policy makers. Finance Minister Roland Lescure said on Tuesday there was no need for the [USN:S8N3XB0C2 TEXT:"European Central Bank"] to step in. Le Pen, the far-right euro-sceptic populist leading the presidential race ahead of next spring's election, set out [USN:L1N45S0C4 TEXT:"plans to slash public spending if elected"], seeking to establish her fiscal credibility as the bond market crisis deepens. French spending on education has lagged inflation and the country's students are trailing their OECD peers in overall performance, data from the[USN:L8N44Z0XI TEXT:" PISA 2025 assessment"] shows.

item.title: Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece, Cyprus keen to join IMEC; ministerial meet likely later this year: France
item.description: Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece and Cyprus have expressed interest in joining the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), French President’s Special Envoy for IMEC Gérard Mestrallet said on ...
item.content:encoded:
Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece, Cyprus keen to join IMEC; ministerial meet likely later this year: France  Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece and Cyprus have expressed interest in joining the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), French President’s Special Envoy for IMEC Gérard Mestrallet said on Tuesday, adding that an IMEC ministerial meeting is expected to be held later this year to consider expanding the corridor’s membership. ANI | Updated: 06-10-2026 19:27 IST | Created: 06-10-2026 19:27 IST

French President’s Special Envoy for IMEC Gérard Mestrallet (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

By Vishu Adhana Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece and Cyprus have expressed interest in joining the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), French President’s Special Envoy for IMEC Gérard Mestrallet said on Tuesday, adding that an IMEC ministerial meeting is expected to be held later this year to consider expanding the corridor’s membership. Mestrallet, who is visiting India from October 5-7 to advance the IMEC project and France-India cooperation on connectivity, said any decision to expand the corridor would have to be taken by its eight existing signatory governments. “We have eight signatories and they are heads of state. Potential extension will only be decided by the eight governments. We hope that in the ministerial meeting we could decide to extend the perimeter of IMEC,” Mestrallet said at a press conference in New Delhi. He specifically named Egypt, Lebanon and Oman among countries interested in working with or joining the corridor, while identifying Greece and Cyprus as two European countries that would be particularly keen to become full members. Mestrallet also clarified that Jordan and Israel, although not among the eight original signatories, were mentioned in the initial agreement. “They have not signed because they were not present. It’s Jordan and Israel, although they were mentioned,” he said. The IMEC was announced in September 2023 by India, the United States, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, France, Germany, Italy and the European Union. The ambitious connectivity initiative envisages linking India with Europe through the Arabian Peninsula using a combination of shipping, rail and other connectivity infrastructure. Mestrallet said that since the creation of IMEC, the participating countries have so far held meetings at the steering committee level, but there has not yet been a ministerial-level meeting. “We hope that by the end of this year there will be a ministerial meeting because in the meantime, since the creation of IMEC, there was only a steering committee, not a ministerial committee,” he said. He stressed that only a ministerial meeting involving the existing governments could decide whether the corridor’s geographical and membership perimeter should be expanded. At the same time, Mestrallet said IMEC would have to work with countries and ports outside the original group irrespective of whether they eventually become full members. “In any case, members or not members, we will have to work with them because they want to work positively, and so we have to work with them to find the best possible method — being a full member or associated member or something else,” he said. The remarks come amid renewed efforts by the participating countries to move ahead with the corridor, which seeks to establish a multimodal connectivity route linking India to the Middle East and Europe, including through ports, rail networks and associated clean-energy and digital infrastructure. Mestrallet is also scheduled to participate in discussions on green shipping corridors and IMEC ports during his India visit. On Tuesday, he spoke at the IMEC Ports Club Working Day in New Delhi alongside Christophe Castaner, Chairman of the Supervisory Board of the Port of Marseille Fos. (ANI)

item.content:encoded:
Pakistan’s power crisis deepens as electricity shortfall crosses 4,000 MW According to ARY News, sources stated that the worsening shortfall has forced power distribution companies (DISCOs) to increase load-shedding across the country. Consumers in both urban and rural areas are reportedly facing three to four hours of power cuts, with the duration of outages increasing suddenly in several areas. ANI | Updated: 06-10-2026 18:43 IST | Created: 06-10-2026 18:43 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Lahore [Pakistan], October 6 (ANI) Pakistan’s electricity crisis has intensified, with the country’s overall power deficit reportedly surpassing 4,000 megawatts as several generation units remain offline and hydropower production declines, as reported by ARY News. According to ARY News, sources stated that the worsening shortfall has forced power distribution companies (DISCOs) to increase load-shedding across the country. Consumers in both urban and rural areas are reportedly facing three to four hours of power cuts, with the duration of outages increasing suddenly in several areas. The situation is particularly difficult in Lahore, where electricity demand has reportedly climbed to around 4,000 megawatts, against an available supply of approximately 3,000 megawatts. This has created a significant gap between demand and supply, adding to pressure on the already strained power distribution system. The latest deterioration has also raised questions over repeated government claims that Pakistan’s electricity shortages had been brought under control. The sources said the promised improvement has failed to materialise as the supply deficit continues to widen. Lahore is also reportedly experiencing a shortage of diesel following disruptions in gas availability, further complicating the city’s energy situation, sources said. Meanwhile, the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) has taken action against K-Electric (KE) over its practice of carrying out load-shedding on feeders based on aggregate technical and commercial (ATC) losses. NEPRA has declared such load-shedding illegal and directed K-Electric to immediately stop unannounced power outages carried out on the basis of feeder losses. The regulator maintained that consumers who regularly pay their electricity bills should not have their supply suspended simply because they are connected to feeders with high losses, as cited by ARY News. NEPRA stressed that paying consumers should not be penalised for electricity theft or other failures by other users. The authority instructed K-Electric to take targeted action against individual consumers involved in electricity theft rather than cutting power to entire feeders, as reported by ARY News. (ANI)

item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / Paramount completes Warner Bros merger to form Hollywood giant Skydance

Paramount completes Warner Bros merger to form Hollywood giant Skydance The combined company will carry about $80 billion in debt, while co-CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz face a target of delivering $6 billion in planned cost savings

In just 16 years, Skydance has gone from an independent studio to the centre of one of Hollywood's biggest power plays | Image: Bloomberg

Reuters 3 min read Last Updated : Oct 06 2026 | 6:33 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Paramount Skydance on Tuesday completed its blockbuster $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros Discovery, creating a Hollywood heavyweight called Skydance and handing CEO David Ellison control of one of the world's largest entertainment companies.   The deal brings together the studios behind "Mission: Impossible," "Harry Potter" and DC Studios alongside major television and streaming networks such as CBS, CNN, Paramount+ and HBO Max — forming an expansive entertainment company spanning film, TV and news.   Shares of the combined company moved to the New York Stock Exchange from Nasdaq on Tuesday to trade under the ticker "SKYD."   Settlements with a coalition of US states and a Hollywood writers union removed the main legal barriers to the merger, one of the largest in media history. It comes as Hollywood faces declining cable-TV subscriptions, the high cost of competing for streaming audiences and persistent pressure from unions over jobs and creative workers' rights.

Ellison said last week the Skydance name was chosen to retain the individual identities of Paramount and Warner Bros studios, rather than combining them under a new brand. Also Read

US judge approves settlement, clearing $81 bn Paramount-Warner Bros. merger

Paramount-Warner $81 bn merger clears key hurdle as states settle lawsuits

Paramount settles US states' lawsuit over $110 bn Warner Bros merger

Paramount settlement talks include penalty for missing 30-film pledge

Paramount settlement talks include plan to keep company in California

Analysts, however, said the name reinforces the extent of Ellison's control, highlighting how some of Hollywood's most iconic brands now answer to him and how he has a platform to impose his strategy and culture.   In just 16 years, Skydance has gone from an independent studio to the centre of one of Hollywood's biggest power plays.   Founded in 2010 by the son of Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, it built its reputation as a financial backer and producer of Paramount's blockbuster "Top Gun: Maverick." After merging with Paramount last year, Skydance set its sights on Warner Bros, entering a heated bidding contest with Netflix while drawing interest from other potential suitors, including Comcast.

Broader hollywood bet   Ellison named Mattel's former CEO Ynon Kreiz as Skydance co-CEO to run day-to-day operations and lead the integration, while Ellison oversees creative direction and overall strategy.   The duo faces the task of combining two large companies while delivering $6 billion in planned cost savings, a big part of which Paramount said would come from "non-labour sources" — by combining streaming technologies and cloud providers of the two companies. However, the scale of the cuts is expected to affect jobs across Hollywood.   The combined company is also expected to carry about $80 billion in debt, putting pressure on Ellison to grow streaming, preserve cash flow from cable networks and improve theatrical film performance.

CNN chief Mark Thompson and CBS News Editor-in-Chief Bari Weiss would continue in their respective leadership roles at Skydance.

item.content:encoded:

East Asia

South Korea's Lee says AI appears to have been used in bank hacks

South Korea's police have launched a full-scale investigation into the hacking attacks against commercial banks that led to a breach of customers' personal information.

South Korean President Lee Jae Myung delivers a speech during the 78th Armed Forces Day at a military base in Gyeryong-City, South Korea, on Oct 1, 2026. (Photo: Jeon Heon-Kyun/Pool via Reuters)

FAST

SEOUL: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Tuesday (Oct 6) that AI models are believed to have been used in some recent hacking incidents against banks and called for the country to develop cybersecurity methods suited to the AI era. "In some hacking incidents, signs have emerged of AI being used, causing considerable public concern and anxiety," Lee said during a Cabinet meeting. "Please establish the circumstances swiftly and clearly, and concentrate personnel and resources on minimising the damage." South Korea's police have launched a full-scale investigation into the hacking attacks against commercial banks that led to a breach of customers' personal information, the Yonhap news agency reported on Tuesday. Shinhan Bank, KB Kookmin Bank and others had reported cyberattacks, the Financial Services Commission (FSC) said on Friday, while Yonhap reported that Hana Bank and Woori Bank had also suffered breaches.

Authorities have not yet disclosed details on what kind of AI tools were used in the hacking incidents or the full scale of the breaches. On Sunday, FSC Chairman Lee Eog-weon convened an emergency meeting with financial industry associations, regulators and executives from affected institutions, warning that the sector must respond with the highest level of vigilance. In September, Australia said an OpenAI agent breached a government health data portal in June, gaining unauthorised access to files, in what could be the first known instance of an AI agent hacking a government website. An artificial intelligence research firm said last week that AI agents tried to hack into a Canadian government website , casting the effort as a failed hacking attempt, while Canada said there were no indications its systems were compromised.

item.title: Balochistan disappearances persist as families face pressure to stay silent
item.description: Reports from Balochistan highlight ongoing enforced disappearances, with three individuals reported missing from Kharan, Kech, and Mastung, while one man returned home in Quetta. Human rights groups ...
item.content:encoded:
Balochistan disappearances persist as families face pressure to stay silent Reports from Balochistan highlight ongoing enforced disappearances, with three individuals reported missing from Kharan, Kech, and Mastung, while one man returned home in Quetta. Human rights groups and families continue to accuse security agencies of arbitrary detentions, with hundreds of cases documented in early 2026. ANI | Updated: 06-10-2026 14:45 IST | Created: 06-10-2026 14:45 IST

Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Reports of enforced disappearances continue to emerge from Balochistan, with three people reportedly missing from Kharan, Kech and Mastung, while another man has returned home in Quetta, highlighting renewed concerns over the region’s human rights situation, as reported by The Balochistan Post. According to The Balochistan Post, Abdul Malik, 37, son of Haji Noor Ahmed and a resident of Kharan, was allegedly taken into custody by the Frontier Corps (FC) at around 2 am on October 2. His family has reportedly been unable to establish his whereabouts since then. In Kech district, 27-year-old Asad Baloch, son of Kauda Dil Murad and a resident of Shapuk, was allegedly taken from his home in Absar, Turbat, during the night of August 18. The alleged abduction was attributed by local sources to an armed group described as a state-backed “death squad”. Another case concerns 18-year-old Mumtaz Baloch, son of Sultan Muhammad and a resident of Mastung. He was reportedly taken from Mastung on June 5. Sources alleged that the Frontier Corps and Military Intelligence (MI) were involved in his disappearance, although the allegations have not been independently verified. Malik Ali Nawaz Baloch, son of Ghulam Jan and a resident of Sariab, Quetta, returned to his family on October 3. He had allegedly disappeared a day earlier, on October 2. The latest cases have once again drawn attention to the long-running problem of enforced disappearances in Balochistan. Families and rights organisations have repeatedly accused Pakistani security and intelligence agencies of detaining people without due process and keeping them incommunicado, as highlighted by The Balochistan Post. The Baloch Yakjehti Committee’s (BYC) Human Rights Department documented 507 alleged enforced disappearances during the first six months of 2026. Quetta and Kech reportedly recorded the highest number of cases, as reported by The Balochistan Post. (ANI)

item.title: Taiwan says it has not heard new US arms sales will be carved into smaller chunks
item.description: Taiwan Defence Minister Wellington Koo said on Tuesday he had not heard that the US was planning on carving up a potential $14 billion arms sale into smaller chunks, but added that Washington's commitments to Taipei's defences had not changed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Taiwan Defence Minister Wellington Koo said on Tuesday he had not heard that the US was planning on carving up a potential $14 billion arms sale into smaller chunks, but added that Washington's commitments to Taipei's defences had not changed. US President Donald Trump has held back approval of the new package of arms sales to Taipei in order to maintain warm relations and a fragile trade truce with Chinese President Xi Jinping. In December, Trump approved an [USN:L1N3XN16Z TEXT:"$11 billion package"]. In May, after meeting Xi in Beijing, Trump said he was holding up a [USN:L1N41S025 TEXT:"second package"] and described it as a "very good negotiating chip." China, which views Taiwan as its own territory, has repeatedly called for the arms sales to end. Officials in Taipei previously said Washington could [USN:L1N45G08H TEXT:"carve up"] the arms sales into smaller chunks in an effort to avoid upsetting Beijing too much. Speaking in parliament, Koo said the US has repeatedly reaffirmed that its commitment to helping Taiwan strengthen its self-defence capabilities has not changed. "Regarding arms sales, we respect the US review process. We are also continuing to coordinate with the United States. At present, we have not received any information about so-called separate batches," he added, without elaborating. A US State Department spokesperson declined to comment on pending arms sales but added that the administration has been very clear that "the enduring US commitment to Taiwan continues" as demonstrated by its arms sale notification in December. The US is bound by law to provide Taiwan with the means to defend itself and Washington is Taipei's most important international backer, despite an absence of formal diplomatic ties. Koo said Taiwan and the US "do indeed have close exchanges in the military and defence spheres." "This will also help us with our current war-preparedness efforts and the transformation of our armed forces." This week, Taiwanese Foreign Minister [USN:L1N45R00A TEXT:"Lin Chia-lung"] and former President [USN:L4N45O08K TEXT:"Tsai Ing-wen"] are in the US, the latter making her first trip to the country since stepping down two years ago. A US State Department spokesperson said, in response to those visits, that the US and international community as a whole benefit from engagement with Taiwan given its tech prowess and the fact it is a vibrant democracy. The Chinese embassy in Washington reiterated that it "firmly opposes official interactions of any form between China's Taiwan region and the US."

item.title: Wall Street shares notch records as oil prices stabilize, bond yields retreat
item.description: World stocks scaled two-week highs on Tuesday with Wall Street indexes setting new records, as steady oil prices and falling bond yields boosted sentiment and investors looked ahead to an earnings season they expect will be powered by AI-driven growth.
item.dc:creator: Lawrence Delevingne, Medha Singh, Stella Qiu
item.content:encoded: World stocks scaled two-week highs on Tuesday with Wall Street indexes setting new records, as steady oil prices and falling bond yields boosted sentiment and investors looked ahead to an earnings season they expect will be powered by AI-driven growth. The S&P 500 (.SPX) hit a [USN:L6N45S16W TEXT:"fresh record"], up about 0.6% on the day, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq (.IXIC) gained 0.45%, also an all-time high. The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 0.5%. The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) [USN:L4N45S182 TEXT:"gained about 0.5%"] and MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe (.MIWD00000PUS) rose 0.6%. Bond markets found [USN:L1N45S0P3 TEXT:"some respite"] on Tuesday after France's contested [USN:L1N45N0A3 TEXT:"budget"] had triggered a French debt rout and fuelled fears of broader stress across the euro zone. The euro rose 0.3% to 1.126, stabilising after hitting a 17-month low in the previous session due to [USN:L6N45S0D2 TEXT:"concerns"] about the euro zone's fiscal outlook. Political uncertainty also deepened after Spain called a [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"snap election"] on Monday. France's 10-year bond yield dipped to 4.7% after surging to its highest since the 2000s last week. Far-right leader Marine Le Pen, the frontrunner in next spring's presidential election, [USN:L1N45S0C4 TEXT:"outlined"] her plans to cut spending if elected in 2027. "On the one hand, you've got quite material pressure being felt on the government bond side. But elsewhere the corporate side of things actually doesn't look too bad. You've got companies whose earnings remain very robust. We're getting into the earnings season fairly soon, expectations for that are pretty high," said James Klempster, deputy head of multi-asset at Liontrust in London. With few major catalysts on this week's calendar, investors are increasingly focused on third-quarter earnings, which begin in earnest next week. Goldman Sachs estimates consensus forecasts imply 27% growth in S&P 500 earnings, with more than half that coming from companies benefiting from AI infrastructure spending. Nvidia (NVDA.O) , the world's most valuable company and a bellwether for the AI trade, ticked up 0.14%, rising closer to a market value of $6 trillion. Brent crude settled slightly higher at about $100.6 a barrel as resilient Middle East [USN:L1N45S05E TEXT:"crude exports"] and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns, though ongoing security risks in the region limited losses. US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude < CLc1 > rose 1 cent to settle at $89.44. Strategists at PIMCO said in a new outlook that they expect stable global growth to continue while inflation moderates as the energy price shock fades and AI-related demand continues to grow. "The global economy has remained resilient," they wrote. BOND WORRIES LINGER The dollar weakened broadly against most major currencies, reversing some recent advances as investors pared back their bets on US interest rate hikes following a soft US jobs report and policymakers' calls for more [USN:S0N44V01O TEXT:"evidence"] before further tightening. The dollar index fell 0.3%, after rising 3% over the past month. Traders scaled back expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase this month to 19% from about 50% a week earlier. Long-dated US Treasury yields also [USN:L1N45S0RM TEXT:"eased"] after touching fresh 24-year highs on Monday, amid a persistent selloff since late August on inflation and debt concerns. The 10-year yield fell 2.7 bps to 5.28%, while the 30-year yield dipped 0.5 bps to 5.65%. Spot gold [USN:L1N45S0G9 TEXT:"rose"] 0.7% to $4,168 an ounce.

FAST

SYDNEY: An Australian Army soldier has died, and five others have been injured during a training exercise in the Northern Territory of Australia, the Defence Department said on Tuesday (Oct 6). The incident occurred at the Mount Bundey Training Area on Oct 5, the department said in a media statement on its website. Five other Australian Army soldiers were injured, it added. No further details of the incident were available. "Next of kin has been notified. Defence will provide further updates when possible," the statement said.

Source: Reuters/nh

item.title: Oil prices stable as market weighs supply risks, rising Middle East exports
item.description: Oil prices were little changed on Tuesday after recovering earlier losses, as the market weighed increases in Middle Eastern crude exports and a planned Group of Seven release of emergency diesel and crude stockpiles against supply concerns related to attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis.
item.dc:creator: Scott Disavino
item.content:encoded: Oil prices were little changed on Tuesday after recovering earlier losses, as the market weighed increases in Middle Eastern crude exports and a planned Group of Seven release of emergency diesel and crude stockpiles against supply concerns related to attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis. Brent futures rose 26 cents, or 0.3%, to settle at $100.58 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude rose one cent to settle at $89.44. Around 12 million barrels per day of crude oil and 2 million bpd of refined products — volumes needed to dampen price pressure — have left the Middle East on tankers in the last seven to 10 days, the [USN:L6N45S0MD TEXT:"CEO of commodity trading giant Vitol"] said on Tuesday. [USN:L1N45S0DH TEXT:"Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman"] said on Tuesday that oil pumped through the East-West Pipeline, which runs to the kingdom's Red Sea export hub of Yanbu, had reached 5.8 million barrels as of Tuesday morning. Oil price declines, however, have been limited by the possibility of further Middle East supply disruptions. [USN:L1N45S0BG TEXT:"Saudi Arabia's airports"] in Jazan and Najran were targeted in two attacks on Monday evening, injuring three people and causing limited damage, the Saudi aviation authority said, as hostilities between the kingdom and Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis escalated. The attacks occurred as Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces pressed a major offensive to retake territory from the Houthis, after weeks of rebel advances, with Riyadh stepping up airstrikes in support of the campaign. Separately, President [USN:L1N45S0UA TEXT:"Volodymyr Zelenskiy"] of Ukraine said on Tuesday that the latest intelligence suggested Russia was preparing a "massive attack." Russia was the world's third-biggest crude oil producer behind the US and Saudi Arabia in 2025, according to US energy data. [USN:L1N45S0RE TEXT:"Sanctions"] designed to keep Russian energy out of global markets have helped support oil prices since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022. A deal to end the Russia-Ukraine war could allow Russia to export more energy. In the US, meanwhile, the [USN:AQN2MMYYH TEXT:"National Hurricane Center"] said there was a 100% chance a cyclone could form over the next seven days in the Gulf of Mexico. A storm in the US Gulf could boost oil prices by shutting oil and natural gas production and damaging other energy infrastructure. OIL STOCKS AROUND THE WORLD The [USN:L6N45S0US TEXT:"International Energy Agency"] will meet next week to work out the details of a diesel stock release as market confusion grows over how many barrels Europe and the US plan to make available to address shortages and record-high prices, sources said. The surge in diesel prices has turned the fuel, which underpins trucking, agriculture and industry, into a global political and economic concern. The wars in Iran and Ukraine have curtailed exports and damaged refineries, helping drive the rise in prices. Under pressure from US President Donald Trump , the [USN:L8N45S0QH TEXT:"Group of Seven"] major economies agreed on Friday to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil from emergency reserves and pledged to refrain from imposing energy export restrictions. With the war in Iran disrupting the flow of Middle East oil supplies, the US Energy Information Administration projected on Tuesday that world petroleum production would drop from a record 106.3 million bpd in 2025 to 101.1 million bpd in 2026, and world oil demand will drop from a record 104.4 million bpd in 2025 to 102.4 million bpd in 2026. In 2027, however, EIA projected world oil supply and demand would rise back to record highs of 109.6 million bpd of production and 104.6 million bpd of consumption. In the US, meanwhile, the oil market was watching for weekly storage reports from the American Petroleum Institute trade group on Tuesday and the EIA on Wednesday. Analysts estimated energy firms added 1.7 million barrels of crude to US storage during the week ended October 2. If correct, it would mark the first time since August that crude stocks increased for three weeks in a row and compare with an increase of 3.7 million barrels in the same week last year and an average increase of 1.7 million barrels over the past five years (2021 to 2025). ,

item.title: Barrick secures 15-year North Mara mining licences in Tanzania
item.description: The latest approval removes tenure risk, leaving Barrick to reverse a sharp first-half production decline.
item.dc:creator: Northern Miner Staff
item.content:encoded:
Barrick secures 15-year North Mara mining licences in Tanzania

Henry Lazenby | October 5, 2026 | 12:10 pm Top Companies   Africa   Canada   Gold

( Image by Twiga Partnership, Facebook. )

Tanzania has renewed Barrick Mining’s (TSX: ABX; NYSE: B) licences for the North Mara gold mine for 15 years, securing its operating tenure as the company weighs an expansion.

North Mara is a combined open-pit and underground operation about 540 km northwest of Dodoma and 20 km south of the Kenyan border. Barrick owns 84% and Tanzania holds the remaining 16%. The mine produced 249,000 attributable oz. last year.

“Relations at North Mara mine have strengthened since Barrick took over,” Tarime district commissioner Maj. Edward Gowele said in Barrick’s Monday release. “Residents now really view the mine as a community partner.”

North Mara’s two special mining licences were last renewed for 15 years in 2012. The latest approval removes that separate tenure risk, leaving Barrick to reverse a sharp first-half production decline, meet North Mara’s attributable 2026 guidance of 200,000 to 230,000 oz. and decide whether to expand the North Mara-Bulyanhulu complex.

Barrick’s Toronto-traded shares were down 1% at $56.84 (US$39.87) apiece by mid-Monday, after tracking 20% higher over the past 12 months. Bids have tested $42.62 and $74.00 over the same period.

Production test

Attributable output fell 47% to 68,000 oz. in the first half from 129,000 oz. a year earlier. All-in sustaining costs rose 79% to US$2,283 per oz. from US$1,272 per ounce. Barrick cited lower grades at North Mara among the factors raising company-wide second-quarter costs.

Barrick maintained North Mara’s guidance at 200,000 to 230,000 oz. and all-in sustaining costs of US$1,520-US$1,680 per oz. The mine must produce 132,000 to 162,000 oz. in the second half to reach that range.

North Mara output is expected to rise next year. Barrick is studying upgrades to remove processing bottlenecks and expand the North Mara-Bulyanhulu complex.

North Mara held attributable proven and probable reserves of 43 million tonnes grading 2.32 grams gold per tonne for 3.2 million oz. at the end of 2025, Barrick reported.

State reset

Barrick bought the 36% of Acacia Mining it didn’t already own in September 2019 and took direct control of North Mara. Under then-CEO Mark Bristow, it reached a settlement with Tanzania the following month and formalized it in January 2020, agreeing to pay $300 million, give the state a 16% free-carried interest in the mines and split their economic benefits equally.

The accord created Twiga Minerals to manage North Mara and Bulyanhulu. Since 2019, Barrick says its Tanzanian operations have contributed about $5.3 billion to the country, including $1.2 billion last year.

LBMA trial

The renewal comes as the London Bullion Market Association prepares for a six-week High Court trial beginning Wednesday over the deaths of two 23-year-old artisanal miners at North Mara in 2019. Their families allege Tanzanian police, private guards or both killed the men in separate incidents that July and December.

Barrick took operational control in September, between the incidents. It isn’t a defendant in the London case and declined to comment to Reuters , the news outlet reported Monday.

The claim alleges the LBMA negligently kept India-based refiner MMTC-PAMP that processed North Mara gold on its ‘good delivery list’ despite reports of abuses at the mine. The list determines which refiners’ bars are accepted in London’s wholesale bullion market.

The LBMA denies liability, saying it certifies refiners rather than mines and had no control over North Mara or Tanzanian police.

The association held about £1.4 million ($1.8 million) in reserves at the end of 2025 and could face £3 million in claimants’ legal costs before damages if it loses, Bloomberg reported on Monday.

A ruling holding the LBMA responsible could set a precedent for compensation over abuses at supplying mines and threaten its role in global gold trading, John Meyer, a mining analyst at SP Angel, said in a note on Monday. The court has stayed another 26 claims and five potential claims until after the trial, according to the LBMA.

item.title: Brazil court order shuts Sigma Lithium mine
item.description: A federal judge suspended Grota do Cirilo’s environmental licences and mining operations on Sept. 4.
item.dc:creator: Northern Miner Staff
item.content:encoded:
Brazil court order shuts Sigma Lithium mine

Northern Miner Staff | October 1, 2026 | 10:28 am News   Regulatory Issues   Latin America   Lithium

Grota do Cirilo is said to be among the world’s largest and highest-grade hard rock lithium deposits. ( Image courtesy of Sigma Lithium. )

Sigma Lithium (TSXV, Nasdaq: SGML; ASX: SAU) has halted all mining and processing at its Grota do Cirilo complex in Brazil, two days after dismissing reports that a court had suspended the operation’s environmental licences.

The shutdown began Wednesday after Sigma received an electronic notice from Minas Gerais state environmental regulator FEAM late the previous day, the company said. Grota do Cirilo, about 450 km northeast of state capital Belo Horizonte, is Sigma’s only producing asset and has annual lithium concentrate capacity of 330,000 tonnes. Its first stage reached commercial production in October 2023 after a C$188-million ($131.9-million) build.

“We lower our rating to ‘market perform (speculative)’ and our target price to $10 as we move to the sidelines pending greater clarity on a number of legal, safety and environmental challenges facing the company,” BMO Capital Markets analyst Joel Jackson said in a note Thursday. “While we recognize the political backdrop in Brazil remains complex, the timing of a return to normalized operations remains uncertain.”

Court ruling

The halt reverses Sigma’s position on Monday, when it said operations were continuing normally and called reports that its licences had been suspended “categorically incorrect.” The restart now depends on a federal appeals court ruling. Sigma kept its 2027 output target but delayed its rolling 12-month guidance by three months.

Sigma’s Toronto shares fell 19% to C$11.16 by mid-Thursday, leaving them about 40% lower this year. They have traded between C$6.51 and C$33.28 over the past 12 months.

A federal judge suspended Grota do Cirilo’s environmental licences and mining operations on Sept. 4 in a civil suit filed by the Federation of Quilombola Communities of Minas Gerais, known as N’Golo. The order also barred state authorities from issuing new licences.

Consultation issue

The dispute centres on whether FEAM should have consulted Baú, a protected Afro-Brazilian community, before licensing the mine. N’Golo says federal mapping places the community’s territory 2.7 km from the operation, inside an 8-km zone that requires prior consultation. The court ordered independent mapping to determine the distance.

The community’s homes are 8 km to 11 km from its pits and the licences predate a November 2023 federal report defining the territory’s proposed boundaries, Sigma maintains. The company denies that its operations have harmed the community.

Sigma said its emergency request to suspend the injunction had awaited a ruling for 15 days. It acknowledged FEAM’s notice on Tuesday evening and halted production the next day. The company didn’t provide an expected date for the appeals court decision.

Sigma kept its 2027 guidance at 330,000 tonnes but delayed its 240,000-tonne 12-month production target. It didn’t say whether the latest postponement comes on top of a three-month deferral announced in August after an earlier shutdown.

Sales of lithium-bearing material recovered from stored tailings will continue, which Sigma says should generate enough cash to fund the company during the halt.

Safety order

Brazil’s National Mining Agency separately ordered Sigma this week to stop work in part of Grota do Cirilo because of an unspecified “imminent risk,” Reuters reported Wednesday.

The regulator ordered immediate repairs to the east wall of the north pit, where it identified a damaged section. The area will remain closed until the work is finished. Sigma’s Thursday release didn’t address that order or provide a repair schedule.

The latest halt follows a five-week shutdown that ended Aug. 21 after Sigma signed an environmental compliance agreement with Minas Gerais. The agreement included up to US$540,000 in fines and about $1 million of environmental work.

Sigma produced 35,400 tonnes in the second quarter and sold 24,400 tonnes for $55 million in revenue. It reported $17 million in cash and $125 million in net debt at June 30.

BMO’s Jackson cut his 2027 production estimate to 207,000 tonnes from 278,000 tonnes and his earnings forecast to $103 million from $194 million. He also delayed his assumed start of Sigma’s second processing plant to mid-2028 from late 2027.

item.title: Beaver Creek: Gold’s bond break puts juniors in play
item.description: The divergence raises the question for mining investors.
item.dc:creator: Northern Miner Staff
item.content:encoded:
Beaver Creek: Gold’s bond break puts juniors in play

Henry Lazenby | October 1, 2026 | 9:00 am News   Canada   USA   Gold

The relationship between gold and bonds changed after Russia invaded Ukraine, panelists said. Credit: Adobe Stock Photo by monsitj.

BEAVER CREEK, COLO. Gold has more than doubled since early 2022 even as U.S. bond yields climbed, a break investors at the Precious Metals Summit say may signal bullion is regaining a monetary role. But the money is reaching junior miners unevenly

Front-month COMEX gold futures ended Sept. 24 at $4,263 per oz., 20% below their Jan. 29 record settlement of $5,318.40, according to Dow Jones market data. The nominal 10-year U.S. Treasury yield reached 5.2% the same day, its highest since 2007, according to the U.S. Treasury.

“It used to be that rising yields were poison for gold,” Sprott (TSX, NYSE: SII) Senior Portfolio Manager John Hathaway told a summit panel moderated by Northern Miner Group President Anthony Vaccaro. “That hasn’t been the case for quite some time, and again, I think it shows cracks in the level of trust in bonds as a safe haven.”

The divergence raises the question for mining investors: will capital now concentrated in bullion and large producers move into explorers and developers? Juniors offer greater leverage to discoveries and rising metal prices, but geological, financing, permitting and dilution risks can erase that upside. Interviews at Beaver Creek show capital still favours advanced projects and established teams over grassroots exploration.

Bond break

For almost two decades, gold generally fell when inflation-adjusted Treasury yields rose because bonds offered a real return while bullion paid none. That relationship held from Jan. 2003 through Feb. 2022, according to data presented by Vaccaro from Bloomberg. Since March 2022, gold and five-year real Treasury yields have risen together.

Ronald-Peter Stöferle, managing partner of Liechtenstein-based fund Incrementum, which manages about €500 million ($570 million), traced the change to Western governments freezing Russian central-bank reserves after Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022. Central banks, particularly in emerging markets, began treating gold as a monetary “Plan B” outside the U.S.-led financial system, he said.

Central banks bought a net 863 tonnes of gold last year, according to the World Gold Council. That was 21% less than in 2024 but well above the 2010-21 annual average of 473 tonnes.

“Central banks continue to buy on dips. They’re just a steady, long-term strategic buyer,” Canadian Mining Hall of Fame member Frank Giustra told The Northern Miner. “The general public hasn’t really been exposed to the gold market yet. Not in ways that I’ve seen through my 45 years in this business.”

Hathaway, whose firm manages $55.3 billion, said further rate increases that erode bond values, an equity selloff or trouble in private equity could weaken confidence in conventional portfolios and drive capital into gold.

Incrementum’s 2026 “In Gold We Trust report” puts the global bond market at about $140 trillion and investment gold at about $14 trillion. A 2% shift from bonds would amount to nearly $3 trillion, about one-fifth of that gold pool.

“The gold market doesn’t have the capacity to absorb those flows without a big price move,” Hathaway said.

Kai Hoffmann, lead portfolio manager at Germany-based Kamavest Asset Management and CEO of junior financing tracker Oreninc, sees a fiscal bind underpinning bullion.

“You raise interest rates, your debt payments explode,” Hoffmann said. “If you don’t raise interest rates, inflation explodes.”

Watch a video of the panel here:

Capital divide

Any flow into mining remains uneven. Global gold exploration budgets rose 11% to $6.15 billion in 2025, S&P Global Market Intelligence said in a June report. Major producers increased spending 15% to $3.5 billion, or 57% of the total.

The industry directed more than half of its exploration spending to lower-risk programs around existing mines. Grassroots exploration received a record-low 18% share. S&P said fundraising by junior and intermediate companies improved, but much of the money went to late-stage development rather than new discoveries.

The imbalance matters because major producers still rely on juniors to find and advance deposits after underinvesting in exploration for more than a decade, Giustra said.

“I think most of the future gold discoveries are going to come from juniors,” he told The Miner.

Oreninc’s coverage universe of smaller companies is on pace for a record fundraising year, Hoffmann said, but explorers still have a harder time raising money than developers.

“There is money available, but I think it’s going towards the pre-development stories,” he said.

Vancouver-based Amarc Resources (TSXV: AHR; US-OTC: AXREF) shows that explorers with established discoveries can still attract institutions. The B.C. copper-gold explorer closed a fully subscribed C$20-million private placement last month. Chair Robert Dickinson said large Canadian and U.S. institutions participated and the financing proceeded more efficiently than earlier raises, although the quality of Amarc’s projects likely helped.

Yukon gold explorer Banyan Gold (TSXV: BYN; US-OTC: BYAGF) closed a C$46.5-million financing in May, bringing its treasury to about C$75 million. Late last month, it announced another C$58-million raise, including a C$20-million commitment from royalty and streaming company Franco-Nevada (TSX, NYSE: FNV).

Advanced projects have more lenders to choose from. Meridian Mining (TSX, LSE: MNO; US-OTC: MRRDF) CEO Gilbert Clark said debt funds, commercial banks and commodity traders have larger sums available but haven’t relaxed their risk tests. Meridian still needs to secure $377 million for its Cabaçal copper-gold project in Brazil.

Equity gap

The industry’s valuation discount is clearest among established producers. The ratio of the Philadelphia Gold and Silver Index to bullion stood at 0.08 on June 30, less than half its long-term average of 0.17, according to Bloomberg data Vaccaro showed.

Companies in the NYSE Arca Gold Miners Index also traded at 5.1 times enterprise value to earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, compared with 15 times for the equal-weighted S&P 500.

Those comparisons mostly cover producers, not early-stage explorers. Institutions entering gold equities would probably begin with large, liquid companies before smaller, specialized pools moved into developers and explorers, Hathaway said.

“Junior companies bring in potential risks of all kinds that you have to judge,” he told The Miner. “But the large companies, I think, are a great place for somebody who doesn’t have exposure to start.”

Developers can offer greater leverage as higher gold-price assumptions lift projected project values and returns. Explorers can deliver larger gains through discovery but produce no cash and depend on repeated financings, leaving returns vulnerable to drilling results and dilution.

Higher prices, however, can revive marginal projects alongside good ones, Hoffmann warned.

Missing buyers

Broader institutional flows haven’t reached juniors at scale. Hoffmann said much of the market still consists of mining specialists trading among themselves, despite Oreninc’s strong fundraising tally.

“The Nasdaq, the S&P, they’re all sitting at record highs,” he said. “There’s no need to chase returns elsewhere.”

Vancouver-based mining investment consultancy Cupel Advisory Director Neil Adshead said fund size itself keeps many generalists out. A manager overseeing $5 billion can’t put meaningful capital into a $50-million junior because its shares are too small and illiquid.

Junior funding instead comes largely from retail and high-net-worth investors and producers, Adshead said. Through his work with Centerra Gold (TSX: CG; NYSE: CGAU), he has helped deploy about C$40 million across six juniors.

“I don’t think there’s any shortage of money at the moment for juniors,” Adshead said.

Utah-based economic geologist and junior-mining investor Brent Cook identified another barrier: investors unfamiliar with geology can struggle to distinguish economic projects from promotional stories. He has seen companies valued at C$50 million to C$300 million raise tens of millions despite projects he considered weak.

Years of dilution, missed targets and value-destructive acquisitions have also left investors wary. Stöferle said miners must continue to rebuild trust by meeting promises and protecting per-share value.

Bull cases

A broad market decline could drive capital into gold while initially hurting juniors dependent on risk capital. Denver-based Crescat Capital founder and CEO Kevin Smith acknowledged that junior gold shares could fall with the wider market, though he expects them to outperform over the short to medium term.

Hathaway said gold could reach $10,000 per oz. within two years if a financial-market breakdown triggered what he called a “Pavlovian” response from monetary authorities — an automatic return to stimulus. A more gradual monetary reset could take about five years, he said.

Crescat’s Smith, with about $600 million in assets under management, sees a path to $20,000 gold within about four years. He said the global monetary base has expanded more than 7% annually for almost a decade, while above-ground gold stocks have grown about 1.5% a year for roughly a century.

Neither forecast guarantees junior-mining gains. A higher gold price can strengthen project economics and access to capital, but it can’t repair poor geology, weak management or an inflated share count.

“The juniors, you need to really understand what that company is looking for,” Cook said. “And you’ve got to understand what success looks like versus failure.”

item.title: テンセントがオラクルからAI半導体10万個をリース、70億ドル規模－FT
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国のテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）は、東南アジアでオラクルから先端のAI半導体を借り受けることで合意した。テンセントにとってAI半導体のリース契約としては過去最大規模となる。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）が事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。
報道によると、テンセントは、5年間の契約の一環として10万個の半導体を利用できるようになる。契約額は70億ドル（約1兆1000億円）に上るという。
中国のAI開発企業は米国の輸出規制を回避するため、米エヌビディア製など中国国内では入手できないAIアクセラレーターを海外で借りて利用している。中国のテクノロジー企業は、東南アジアのデータセンターの最大顧客層の一つとなっている。
テンセントとオラクルの担当者は、ブルームバーグ・ニュースのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。
原題：Tencent Leases AI Chips From Oracle

item.title: 日銀｢主な意見｣で円下落、10月利上げの示唆乏しい－短観も決め手欠く
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 1日の外国為替市場で円が対ドルで下落した。日本銀行が公表した金融政策決定会合の「主な意見」は、10月の追加利上げの手がかりを期待していた投資家にとって物足りない内容となった。

円は一時ニューヨーク終値比0.5%安の158円22銭まで下落。主要10通貨（G10）で最も下げた。

外為どっとコム総合研究所の神田卓也シニア為替アナリストは、主な意見は「タカ派的な意見が多かったが、連続利上げ期待を強めるほどではなかった」と指摘。ただ、158円台では介入警戒感がドルの上値を抑える可能性が高いとみている。

日銀が31年ぶり高水準への政策金利引き上げを決めた9月会合の主な意見では、政策運営の重点がインフレ率の上振れを防ぐことに移っているとの認識が改めて示された。中立金利が市場推計値より上振れる可能性があることや、これまでの利上げによる影響は限定的だとみる企業が多いとの指摘があったほか、早期の政策金利引き上げが望ましいとの意見が示された。

翌日物金利スワップ（OIS）市場では、10月の利上げ確率が約20%と、一時30%を超えた前日から低下。一方、12月までの利上げは完全に織り込まれている。

債券市場では超長期債を中心に金利が上昇しており、市場がインフレ対応で日銀が後手に回ることを警戒している可能性を示唆する。

9月会合後は日銀が今後の利上げペースについてより強い指針を示さなかったとの受け止めから円安が進み、金融当局がニューヨーク時間に市場参加者に為替水準を照会するレートチェックを実施したと報じられた。財務省は9月30日、直近1カ月の為替介入額はゼロ円だったと公表した。

米国では連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が先月、全会一致で利上げを決定し、年内にもう1回の追加利上げを支持する姿勢を示した。

オーストラリア・コモンウェルス銀行のストラテジスト、サマラ・ハムード氏は「日銀が市場の期待に応えるハードルは高い」と話す。「9月の利上げ決定で票が割れたことや、FRBがよりタカ派的になっていることを踏まえると、日銀がより明確なフォワードガイダンスを示さない限り、利上げ観測が円を支える効果は限られる」との見方を示した。

item.title: 高市政権、予算改革元年は「総力戦」で最適解探る－国債発行が鍵に
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 恒常的な補正予算から脱却する改革元年は、防衛費や投資枠などで歳出が膨張する一方、消費減税で歳入の減少が見込まれる。国債発行額も野放図に増やせない制約があり、政府は「総力戦」で歳出・歳入両面の精緻化を進める。

年末の閣議決定を目指す2027年度予算案は、高市早苗政権が概算要求段階から取り組む初めての当初予算となる。8月末に締め切った概算要求は143.1兆円だったが、このほかに金額を示さない事項要求もあり、実際の総額規模は見えづらい。

今回の予算編成では、これまで以上に政府の知恵が問われる。債券市場が高市財政に厳しい視線を投げかける中、想定を超える国債発行額となれば金利上昇につながる可能性があるためだ。片山さつき財務相は「国債発行額を市場の信認を得られるようなレベルにコントロールしていく」と強調するが、市場の許容度を推し量るのは容易ではない。

国債発行額を抑制する方法は、歳出を抑えるか、歳入を増やすしかない。歳出側では財務省主計局の査定能力が問われる。特に、成長投資のための「新たな投資枠」では、民間の動きを誘発できる案件にどれだけ絞り込めるのかが焦点だ。

歳入は主に財務省主税局による税収見積もりが鍵を握る。過去数年の税収は当初見積もりから上振れる傾向にあり、9月30日の経済財政諮問会議では、税収の分析で財務省と内閣府の連携を求める有識者提言が出た。当初予算編成の段階で税収見込みを増やせれば、国債発行額を抑える効果が見込める。

ただ、国債発行額を縮小する目的で税収の見積もり方法を変えれば、「恣意（しい）的」との批判を招く可能性もあり、慎重な判断が求められる。

税外収入をどれだけ積み上げられるかも重要だ。過去の事例を踏まえると、外国為替資金特別会計（外為特会）の剰余金を一般会計に全額繰り入れる手法が有力視されそうだ。

加えて、財務省理財局の視点が不可欠となる。従来の予算編成では、主計局が歳出の規模を決めるとともに主税局が税収を見積もり、理財局は最後に差額分を国債発行で埋め合わせるという、「帳尻合わせ」の役割を担ってきた。

item.title: トランプ氏、ディーゼル輸出禁止への意欲後退－ガソリン値上がり警戒
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は米国産ディーゼル燃料の輸出禁止案について、予期せぬ価格高騰のリスクを踏まえ、実行に移す意欲が後退していることを示唆した。政権幹部の一人は、欧州が近くディーゼル燃料の供給を増やす可能性も示した。

トランプ氏は9月30日、記者団に対し、海外向けディーゼル燃料販売の規制についてライト・エネルギー長官、バーガム内務長官と引き続き検討していると説明。一方、広範な輸出禁止が意図しない結果を招きかねないとする両氏の懸念も認めた。

トランプ氏は「彼らはディーゼル燃料価格の抑制に多少役立つと考えているが、ほかのものの価格を押し上げる可能性がある。原油価格はこれから下がり始めるため、今は良い状況にあると思う」と指摘。「ガソリンには悪影響がありそうだ。ガソリン価格が少し上がり、ディーゼル燃料価格は少し下がる。われわれは非常に良い状態にあると考えている」とした。

ディーゼル燃料価格は記録的な上昇となっており、中間選挙を数週間後に控える米政権に圧力が強まっている。中間選挙で共和党は議会で多数派を失う可能性がある。特に生活費の高さを巡り、有権者のトランプ氏への評価は低い。

ライト氏は30日、高値を和らげる可能性のある動きとして、「欧州の友人たちから、市場に新たに供給されるディーゼル燃料について発表があるだろう」と述べた。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、輸出禁止には至らない個別対策も検討している。事情に詳しい関係者が内部協議を理由に匿名で語ったところでは、米国産ディーゼル燃料への依存度が高い欧州の一部の国に、在庫放出を促す案などがある。

米当局者は、イラン戦争を受けた石油備蓄の協調放出を巡り、欧州諸国の対応が米国や日本に比べ出遅れていると不満を示してきた。ライト氏は、欧州の複数国が「約束した原油と石油製品のごく一部しか放出していない」と述べている。

原題：Trump Downplays Diesel Export Ban Over Impact on Other Fuels（抜粋）

item.title: パイロットが意図的に墜落させた旅客機、過去の事例を振り返る
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）のドバイを離陸しイスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていたフライドバイの旅客機内で、パイロットの1人が同僚を刺した疑いがあり、機体が急降下してサウジアラビアに緊急着陸する事態となったが、間一髪で大惨事を免れた。

この事件を受け、操縦室の乗務員のメンタルヘルスを巡る懸念が再燃し、過去に起きた操縦士による殺人・自殺事件が改めて注目されている。

こうした事例はまれだが、前例がないわけではない。米連邦航空局（FAA）が2014年に発表した調査報告によると、2003－2012年に発生した死者を伴う航空事故2758件のうち、8件が航空機を使った殺人・自殺と認定された。

ブルームバーグ・ニュースが2022年に行った調査では、航空機の信頼性が高まり、操縦士のミスも減る中で、操縦士が意図的に航空機を墜落させたことによる死者の割合が、航空機事故による死者全体の中で拡大していることが分かった。

意図的な行為は従来、航空機事故の統計には含まれていないが、ブルームバーグがまとめたデータによれば、仮に含めた場合、世界の航空機事故による死者の原因別で2番目に大きなカテゴリーとなる。

ロンドン行きのエア・インディア機がインドのアーメダバードを離陸して32秒後に墜落した。ボーイングの787ドリームライナーが空港敷地外の人口密集地に墜落し、乗客・乗員241人と地上の19人が死亡した。乗客1人が奇跡的に生還した。

インドの航空当局は最終報告書をまだ公表しておらず、この墜落事故がパイロットの自殺だったとも公式には確認していない。ただ、2025年7月に公表された暫定報告書によると、操縦室にある二つの燃料制御スイッチが相次いで「run（運転）」から「cutoff（遮断）」に切り替わった後、両エンジンが停止した。スイッチがなぜ切り替わったのか、誰が操作したのかは特定されなかった。

item.title: 「トゥキディデスのわな」とは？ なぜ習氏がトランプ氏に語るのか
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国の習近平国家主席は9月下旬、ワシントンでトランプ米大統領と会談した際、「トゥキディデスのわな」を回避するため、米中協力を一段と強化するよう呼びかけた。

学術的にも聞こえるこの言葉は、米中関係を巡る中国政府の構想の核心に関わる。習氏がこの言葉を持ち出したのは今回が初めてではない。トランプ氏が5月に北京を訪問したときにも、同じ考えに言及していた。

この言葉を2010年代前半に広めたのは、米ハーバード大学の政治学者グレアム・アリソン氏だ。古代ギリシャの歴史家トゥキディデスの記述を踏まえたもので、台頭しつつある大国がすでに覇権を握っている大国に挑戦すると、必然的に衝突が起き得るというのがアリソン氏の主張だ。同氏の研究では、歴史上このパターンが繰り返されてきたとされ、米中対立を考察する枠組みとして用いている。

簡単に言えば、構造的な緊張を巡る問題だ。経済とテクノロジー、軍事の各方面で中国が存在感を高め、世界の超大国として長年君臨してきた米国の優位が揺さぶられている。米中どちらも対立を望んでいなくても、競争そのものがコントロールしにくい圧力を生み出すリスクがある。

トゥキディデスは紀元前5世紀のギリシャの歴史家で、当時のペロポネソス戦争について、台頭する都市国家アテネと、すでに覇権を握っていたスパルタとの避けられない衝突だったと説明した。アリソン氏はこの記述を基に「トゥキディデスのわな」という言葉を生み出した。

北京を拠点とするアナリスト、王子辰氏によると、習氏がこの概念を使い始めたのは少なくとも2014年にさかのぼる。王氏は習氏が過去にこの枠組みに言及した事例を調査した。習氏は2024年11月、ペルーで開かれたアジア太平洋経済協力会議（APEC）首脳会議に合わせて当時のバイデン米大統領と会談した際にも、この言葉を使った。

item.title: メキシコ・ペソに売り、「キャリー取引の宴は終わった」－金利差縮小
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： メキシコ・ペソは過去1カ月のパフォーマンスが他のあらゆる主要通貨を下回った。これを受け、アナリストが年末予想を相次ぎ引き下げている。

ソシエテ・ジェネラル、モルガン・スタンレー、バンコ・バセはいずれもペソ予想を下方修正した。低金利通貨で資金を調達し、高金利通貨で運用するキャリー取引の投資家がこの市場から撤退している。

ペソは9月初めに2年ぶりの高値を付けたものの、月間で約6%下落し、ブルームバーグが追跡する全通貨で最も低調だった。かつて「スーパーペソ」と呼ばれたペソだが、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）の利上げと、その後のメキシコ中銀の金利据え置きを受けて金利差が縮小し、売られた。この金利差が人気のキャリー取引を支えてきた。

ソシエテ・ジェネラルの新興国市場ストラテジスト、ブレンダン・マッケナ氏（ニューヨーク在勤）は「今回の売りが始まる前から、ペソは脆弱（ぜいじゃく）性を抱えていた」と指摘。「メキシコ中銀がFRBと足並みをそろえず、金利差の縮小を容認する姿勢を確認すると、ペソの脆弱性が表面化し、相場がそれを反映した」と述べた。

ブルームバーグがまとめたデータによると、米国とメキシコの金利差はこの1年だけで半減し、少なくとも2008年以来の低水準に縮小した。

メキシコ中銀が9月24日に政策金利を据え置いた後、ソシエテ・ジェネラルは年末のペソ予想を足元とほぼ同水準の1ドル＝18ペソに修正した。中銀の政策決定前は17.25ペソを見込んでいた。

モルガン・スタンレーは今週、10－12月（第4四半期）の予想を1ドル＝18.25ペソとし、従来予想より6%のペソ安水準に修正した。バンコ・バセも28日、10－12月期の予想をこれまでの17.80ペソから18.20ペソに修正した。

バンコ・バセの経済分析責任者、ガブリエラ・シラー氏は「キャリー取引の宴は終わった」と述べた。

ドイツ銀行のストラテジスト、カルロス・ムニョス・カルカモ氏は先週のリポートで、ペソについて「キャリー取引としての魅力が薄れている」と指摘。他の通貨と比べても割高感が強く、ポジションも「積み上がり過ぎているようだ」とした。ドイツ銀のストラテジストは年末予想を従来の1ドル＝17.5ペソから18.20ペソに修正した。

item.title: ニデック債、上乗せ金利さらに拡大－監査法人が有報に意見不表明
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ニデックの社債スプレッド（国債との利回り差）が一段と拡大し、223ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）となった。前期（2026年3月期）の有価証券報告書で監査法人が監査意見を表明しなかったことなどから、格付け引き下げや株式の上場廃止を巡る警戒が強まっている。

ブルームバーグのデータによると、2032年7月償還のニデック債のスプレッドは3月上旬以来の高水準で、直近3営業日で約39bp拡大した。

ニデックが30日に提出した前期の有報で、監査法人PwCジャパンは連結財務諸表に対する意見を表明しなかった。この期は6321億円の減損損失を計上し、純損益は5646億円の赤字となった。

フジワラキャピタルの土屋剛俊社長は、格下げや上場廃止のリスクが意識される中、機関投資家には不祥事を抱える銘柄を保有し続けることへの説明責任が生じるため、万が一に備えて売却する動きが出やすいと分析する。「不祥事はどういう風に転ぶか分からない」と述べ、予防的にリスクを落とす動きが出ているとの見方を示した。

また、三菱UFJ銀行と三井住友銀行との各3000億円のコミットメントライン契約で財務制限条項に抵触したことも明らかにした。両行は期限の利益喪失請求権を放棄しており、3月末時点の実行残高はゼロだった。

ブルームバーグは銀行借り入れの実行状況や、11月に期限を迎えるコミットメントラインの更新・再契約について同社に取材を試みたが、現時点でコメントは得られていない。

item.title: AI関連以外も米経済押し上げ－ミネアポリス連銀のカシュカリ総裁
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米ミネアポリス連銀のカシュカリ総裁は9月30日、AI関連の建設ブームを除けば米経済は縮小しているとの見方に懐疑的な見解を示した。

カシュカリ総裁はニューヨーク市内で開かれた外交問題評議会（CFR）のイベントで、「経済のその他の部分が縮小しているという見方には懐疑的だ」と指摘。「企業利益を見ると、AI関連の設備投資に直接関係する分野だけでなく、経済の多くのセクターで総じて非常に力強く増加している」と話した。

また、失業率が4.1%であることに加え、「全米で解雇が非常に少なく、失業保険申請件数も非常に少ない」と述べた。一方、住宅市場が圧迫されていることは認めた。

カシュカリ総裁は「経済の多くのセクターは堅調だと思う。ただ、AIが明らかに成長の真のけん引役だ」と語った。

米金融当局者は9月15、16両日の連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）会合で、2023年以来となる利上げを全会一致で決めた。当局者の四半期経済予測の中央値によると、年内にあと1回の追加利上げ見通しも示された。

カシュカリ総裁は、自身の予測は中央値と一致していると述べる一方、新たなデータ次第で見通しが変わる可能性があると語った。

カシュカリ総裁は、インフレ率は依然として高過ぎるとし、連邦準備制度が小幅な調整によって物価上昇を抑制できることを期待していると述べた。

米金融当局者の間では、インフレが中東での紛争や関税の影響を受ける品目だけにとどまっていないとの懸念が強まっている。

カシュカリ総裁は「エネルギーは、われわれが購入するほぼ全てのものに関わっている」とし、「企業に聞いてみれば分かる。燃料価格の上昇に加え、人手の確保が難しくなっていることもあり、経済全体で輸送コストが上昇している」と説明した。

原題：Fed’s Kashkari Says AI Not Only Driver of US Economic Growth（抜粋）

item.title: 【日本市況】158円台に円下落､利上げ期待後退－日銀後手懸念し債券安
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 1日の日本市場では、円が対ドルで158円台に下落。米国で個人消費の好調が示されドルが堅調な中、日本銀行の金融政策決定会合の「主な意見」が連続利上げへの期待を強める内容とならず、円売りが進んだ。債券は下落（利回りは上昇）。株式は日経平均株価が続伸している。

日銀が公表した9月の決定会合の主な意見では、物価上振れの兆候が見えれば、利上げのペースを速めざるを得ないとの意見が政策委員から示された。一方、内閣府からの出席者は「既往の利上げが累積的に与える影響」について十分点検するよう求めた。同会合では、政策金利を31年ぶりの高水準となる1.25%に引き上げた。

あおぞら銀行の諸我晃チーフマーケットストラテジストは、主な意見について「10月の連続利上げを示唆するような材料は出ておらず、政府側からのコメントも今まで通りの印象だ」と語った。全体的に無難な内容で、発表前に警戒で買われていた円が売られているのではないかと分析した。

円は対ドルで下落し、一時158円22銭と9月25日以来の安値を付けた。

外為どっとコム総合研究所の神田卓也シニア為替アナリストは、日銀の主な意見が「連続利上げ期待を強めるほどタカ派ではなかったことが円売りにつながっている可能性がある」との見方を示した。同時に公表された日銀の企業短期経済観測調査（短観）については「大企業製造業の景況感は予想を若干下回ったが、前回から改善しておりおおむね予想通りの内容だった」と言う。

9月の短観では、大企業製造業の景況感がプラス24と6四半期連続で改善し、約8年半ぶりの高水準となった。市場予想のプラス25は下回った。

債券は堅調な米経済指標や財政懸念を背景に下落。日銀の連続利上げ期待が後退する一方、インフレ対応が後手に回るビハインド・ザ・カーブへの懸念も意識され、長期・超長期債を中心に売りが出ている。新発30年債利回りは6bp高い4.2%に上昇した。
